Andaman & Nicobar Police Group-B(NG) & Group-C Eligibility Criteria 2026

Nationality: Candidate must be a citizen of India.

Essential Educational Qualification (as on 17/05/2026) (Varies by post – Graduate / Higher Secondary / Matric Level)

  • Graduate Level Posts (e.g., Sub-Inspector (Executive), Radio Operator (ASI), etc.): Bachelor’s Degree in relevant discipline + valid driving license (LMV) in most cases.
  • Higher Secondary Level Posts (e.g., Constable (Executive), Sub-Inspector (Master), etc.): 12th Pass + specific technical/skill requirements.
  • Matric Level Posts (e.g., Fitter Electrician, Diesel Mechanic, Follower posts): 10th Pass + ITI/NTC/NAC in relevant trade + experience + driving license where applicable.

Desirable Qualifications mentioned for some posts (e.g., Fire Service experience, Sub-Officer Course).

Andaman & Nicobar Police Group-B(NG) & Group-C Age Limit 2026

Crucial date: 17/05/2026

Category / Post Type Age Limit
Sub-Inspector posts (most) Not exceeding 30 years
Constable (Executive), Bandsmen, VHF Operator 18-25 years (Male) / 18-30 years (Female)
Many Follower / Technical posts 18-33 years (Male) / 18-38 years (Female)
Others (Driver, Mechanic, etc.) 18-25 or 18-33 years as per post

Age Relaxation:

  • ST: 5 years
  • OBC: 3 years
  • Govt. Servants / Departmental candidates: Additional relaxation as per rules
  • Ex-Servicemen: As per Govt. orders
  • DRM/Contractual staff: As per A&N Administration circular

Andaman & Nicobar Police Group-B(NG) & Group-C Application Fee 2026

  • Candidates (except Female/ST candidates who are exempted from payment of fee) are required to pay a fee of Rs. 100/- (Rupees one hundred only) 
  • No Fee for ST/Women candidates of any community. No "fee exemption" is available to Gen/OBC/EWS male candidates and they are required to pay the full prescribed fee.
  • After completing payment: candidate has to upload the transaction slip in the portal in image format.

Andaman & Nicobar Police Group-B(NG) & Group-C Selection Process 2026

  • Physical Measurement and Endurance Test (PM&ET): Qualifying in nature (Height, Chest for males, Race, Long Jump, High Jump, Swimming for some posts).
  • Written Examination: Objective type (Graduate / Higher Secondary / Matric Level) – Common + Additional papers as per post. Negative marking of 0.25.
  • Trade Test / Skill Test (wherever applicable): Qualifying in nature for technical/driver/bandsmen/marine posts.
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination
  • Final merit based on performance in Written Exam + Trade Test (subject to qualifying PM&ET and other conditions).

Andaman & Nicobar Police 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must upload/produce originals at verification:

  • Recent passport size photo & signature
  • Matric / 12th / Degree / Diploma certificates & mark sheets
  • Experience certificates (wherever required)
  • Valid Driving License
  • Caste / Category certificate (ST/OBC/EWS)
  • ESM / MSP certificate (if applicable)
  • NOC for Govt. employees / Departmental candidates
  • Other relevant documents as per post

How to Apply for Andaman & Nicobar Police 2026

  • Apply online only via official A&N Police website.
  • Fill details, upload documents/photo/signature, submit.
  • Print application for records.
  • Departmental candidates must route through proper channel with NOC.
  • Keep email/mobile active.

Last date: As notified (closing date 17/05/2026 mentioned in document)

Andaman & Nicobar Police Group-B(NG) & Group-C Online Application Form

Eligible candidates can apply online through the A&N Police recruitment portal. Complete registration, fill application, and submit before the deadline.

Click Here to Apply Online

Additional Benefits: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, and other allowances as per rules.

  • Read notification carefully before applying.

  • Govt. strives for gender balance; women candidates are encouraged to apply.
  • No TA/DA for tests.

Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) has released the official notification for Instructor Recruitment 2026, inviting online applications for 726 Instructor posts across various trades. This recruitment offers a great opportunity for candidates with Graduate, Diploma, and ITI qualifications to secure a government job in Bihar.

The recruitment includes vacancies in multiple trades such as Survey, Machinist, Fitter, Welder, Electronics Mechanic, Electrician/Wireman, and more. BTSC Instructor Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Instructor (Various Trade): 

  • Must have completed Related Trade Course (1 or 2 years) from a recognized institute
  • Institute must be approved by:
    • NCVT (National Council for Vocational Training), New Delhi OR
    • SCVT (State Council for Vocational Training), Patna

Instructor (Electrician/Wireman):

  • Must have completed Electrician/Wireman Trade Course (1 or 2 years)
  • Institute must be approved by: NCVT OR SCVT

Instructor (Electrician)

  • Must have passed Matriculation (10th Class) or equivalent
  • Must have completed ITI Training in:
    • Electrician Trade OR Wireman Trade
  • Must possess Apprenticeship Training Certificate in relevant trade

  • Candidates with regular course training in the respective trade will be given preference

BTSC Instructor Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

BTSC Instructor Recruitment 2026 How to Apply

Visit Official Website

  • Open the official website of Bihar Technical Service Commission: btsc.bihar.gov.in or the BTSC online application portal btsc.pariksha.nic.in.
  • Click on the “Recruitment / Online Application” or “Apply Online” link for Advt. No. 14/2026 to 22/2026 – Instructor Posts.

New Registration

  • Click on “New Registration”.
  • Enter basic details (name, mobile number, email ID, date of birth, category etc.) and submit to generate your Registration ID and password.
  • Note/save the Registration ID and password for future logins.

Fill Online Application Form

  • Login using your Registration ID and password.
  • Select the relevant advertisement number and Instructor trade you wish to apply for (Survey, Machinist, Automobile Engineering, Leather Technology, Welder, Mechanic Tractor, Agriculture & Machinery, Fitter, Electronics Mechanic / Mechanic Radio & TV, Electrician/Wireman).
  • Fill all required details carefully: personal information, address, educational qualifications (Graduate/Diploma/ITI), experience (if applicable) and reservation details.

Upload Documents

  • Upload scanned copies of the following in the prescribed format and size (as mentioned in the notification):
  • Recent passport size photograph
  • Signature
  • Educational qualification certificates (Graduate/Diploma/ITI)
  • Category/caste certificate (if applicable)
  • Domicile, disability, and other relevant certificates if required.

Pay Application Fee

  • Proceed to the payment section and pay the application fee through online mode (debit card, credit card, net banking, UPI), as per your category, once the fee details are notified.
  • After successful payment, your application will be marked as “Fee Paid / Completed”.

Final Submit Application

  • Re‑check all the details filled in the form.
  • Click on “Final Submit” to submit the application form.
  • Take a printout/PDF of the final submitted application form and payment receipt for future reference (written exam, document verification etc.).

Important Instructions

  • Apply only through online mode; no offline form will be accepted.
  • Complete your application and fee payment before 15-05-2026 to avoid last‑minute issues.
  • Keep your registered mobile number and email ID active for all BTSC communication (exam date, admit card, updates).

Applications must be submitted online only through the BPSSC website. Hard copy of applications need not be sent to the Commission. Candidates should visit https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in and click on the "Home Guard" tab, then click the link related to Advt. No. 05/2026 to begin the application process. Only one online application can be submitted per candidate. If multiple applications are submitted by a candidate, all will be rejected and legal action may also be taken.

The online application is filled in two parts. In Part 1, candidates register with their name, nationality, mobile number, email ID, domicile, reservation category, gender, and date of birth, followed by fee payment. After successful payment, Registration ID and Password are sent via SMS and Email. In Part 2, candidates fill in father/husband name, mother's name, address, educational qualifications, upload photograph and signature, and finally submit the application.

Photo and Signature Upload Requirements:

  • Photograph: Colour, taken within last 2 months, white background, between 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format
  • Signature: In English and Hindi (black or blue ink), separate, white background, between 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format

  • Examination fee is non-refundable; fee charged back from bank will result in rejection and legal action.
  • Only one application per mobile number is allowed. Candidates must be physically present with mobile phone during registration as Registration ID and Password are sent by SMS.
  • Date of Birth will be calculated strictly as per Matriculation or equivalent certificate.
  • Married/divorced/separated female candidates applying under reserved category must submit caste certificate based on their father's caste (not husband's), as caste is determined by birth, not marriage.
  • EWS certificate must be based on income and assets for financial year 2025-26 as per prescribed format from General Administration Department, Bihar.
  • The selection process may take approximately 6 months. No extension will be granted for any reason (personal, medical, pregnancy, fracture, etc.) at any stage.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check the BPSSC website and keep their registered mobile/email active for all updates.

The Preliminary Examination is a qualifying/screening test only - marks obtained in it will not be counted for the final merit list. Candidates qualifying the Mains will be called for Personality Test at 2.5 times the number of vacancies (category-wise).

Candidates must mandatorily select their service/post preference in the Main Exam online application - no post/service preference claim will be entertained later.

The Preliminary Examination consists of a single General Studies paper (150 marks, 2 hours, MCQ). The Main Examination consists of General Hindi, General Studies Papers I & II, Essay, and one Optional subject. Questions in the Main Examination papers will be in both Hindi and English. How to Apply for BPSC 72nd CCE Recruitment 2026

Hard copy applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. The online portal will be active from 07-05-2026 to 31-05-2026. New users must complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the BPSC portal - only one OTR per candidate is permitted. Multiple OTR registrations can lead to rejection of candidature.

All supporting documents must be uploaded in PDF format (max 100 KB per document) at the time of filling the online application. A valid and working email ID and mobile number are mandatory and must be kept active until final results are published. Candidates must upload a live webcam photograph during application - the background must be white or light-coloured with sufficient light. Hindi and English signatures must both be scanned and uploaded (jpg/jpeg format, max 15 KB, dimensions 220x100 pixels).

  • Age relaxation proof (if claiming upper age relaxation)

Apply Online at: https://bpsconline.bihar.gov.in

Important Instructions for BPSC 72nd CCE Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian citizens with valid Bihar domicile (for reservation benefits) are eligible to apply; candidates from outside Bihar can apply under UR category only.
  • Candidates must possess the prescribed minimum qualification (Graduation) on the closing date of application.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted - online submission only via BPSC OTR portal.
  • Examination fee is non-refundable; incomplete applications without fee will be rejected.
  • Only one OTR registration per candidate is allowed; multiple OTR registrations can lead to rejection.

  • Submitting wrong/incomplete/misleading information in the online application will make the candidate solely responsible for adverse consequences.
  • All updates/corrigendum/errata will be published only on https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in - candidates must check regularly.
  • Negative marking of 1/3 mark applies for each wrong answer in the Preliminary Examination.
  • Candidates must keep 4 copies of their recent photograph safely for use when requested by the Commission.

APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

I. Educational Qualification – Junior Specialist (Allopathy)

  • A recognised medical qualification included in the First or Part-II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualification) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Holders of Part-II qualifications must also fulfil the condition stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Act.
  • Post-Graduate Degree in the concerned specialty mentioned in Section 'A', 'B', or 'D' as the case may be in Schedule VI or equivalent of Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules, 2000.
  • The candidate (including Foreign Medical Graduates/Post Graduates) must be registered with Arunachal Pradesh Medical Council (APMC).

II. Educational Qualification – Junior Dental Specialist

  • Medical qualification included in Part-I or Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentist Act, 1948 as amended from time to time.
  • Post-Graduate Degree in the concerned specialty mentioned in Section 'A', 'B', or 'D' as the case may be in Schedule-VI or equivalent of Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules, 2000.
  • The candidate (including Foreign Medical Graduates/Post Graduates) must be registered with Arunachal Pradesh Dental Council (APDC).

One Time Relaxation (GoAP): The Government of Arunachal Pradesh has granted One Time Relaxation vide GoAP Notification No. DMETR-11012(17)/1/2024 dated 7th February 2026, waiving off the requirement of 3 years' experience after Post Graduate Degree and 5 years' experience after Post Graduate Diploma in the concerned Speciality.

Age Limit

Candidates must not exceed 50 years as on the last date of submission of online application form (18th May 2026), in accordance with One Time Relaxation vide GoAP Notification No. DMETR-11012(17)/1/2024 dated 7th February 2026. Age relaxation of 5 years is available for Government Servants. Age concession for PwBD candidates and regular Govt. servants of Government of Arunachal Pradesh will be as per Government rules in force.

APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection will be made through Viva-Voce / Interview only in accordance with the Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules-2000 amended vide Notification No. HFW-1/89(Pt) dated 31/10/2003. The total marks of Interview shall be 100 marks.

  • Candidates must score a minimum of 50% of the total marks in the interview to qualify for selection (as per Rule XI, Sub-rule (e) of APPSC Manual for Conduct of Examination-2024).
  • Relaxation for PwBD candidates, if any, shall apply as per the Government notification.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on information provided in the online application form.
  • Eligible candidates must produce all original certificates/documents/mark sheets at the time of interview. If a candidate is found ineligible during document verification, candidature shall be rejected.
  • The date for interview of eligible candidates will be notified in due course.

Documents to Be Uploaded with Online Application

  • Signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (40–50 kb, jpg format).
  • Latest/recent colour passport-size photo (40–100 kb, jpg format) — white background, front-faced, without headgear or sunglasses.
  • Self-attested photocopy of Matriculation Certificate/Marksheet with Date of Birth (only document accepted as proof of DOB).
  • Self-attested photocopy of APST certificate (for APST candidates seeking reservation).
  • Self-attested photocopy of Aadhaar Card / PRC / EPIC as identity proof (for non-APST applicants).
  • Self-attested photocopy of Bachelor Degree certificates and mark sheets issued by the University.
  • Self-attested photocopy of Master Degree certificates and mark sheets issued by the University.
  • Experience Certificate in the concerned speciality, if any.
  • PwBD/PwD disability certificate issued by certifying authority as per Section 57 of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 — must clearly mention the Percentage of Disability and must be issued before the last date of application submission.
  • Self-attested photocopy of APMC Registration Certificate (for Allopathy) or APDC Registration Certificate (for Dental).
  • Govt. employees: Copy of intimation submitted to Head of Department or NOC issued by the department.

How to Apply for APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only at https://appsc.gov.in. One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory before filling the application form.

Apply Online – appsc.gov.in

1. Complete One Time Registration (OTR): Visit https://appsc.gov.in and mandatorily register for OTR before filling the online application form. Candidates who have already registered in OTR can directly log in with the same user ID and password.

2. Fill the Online Application Form: The online application link will be active from 17th April 2026 (1700 hrs) to 18th May 2026 (1700 hrs). Fill all details carefully and accurately. The application form once submitted within the last date shall be complete in all respects — no additional time will be provided for further changes.

3. Upload Required Documents: Upload scanned copies of all required documents (as listed in Point E of the notification) in the prescribed format and file size. Ensure all uploads are clear and self-attested.

4. Pay Application Fee: Pay the applicable fee — ₹150/- for APST candidates, ₹200/- for others. PwBD candidates are exempted. Fee payment is through the online mode on the APPSC portal.

5. Submit Application: Read the DISCLAIMER provided in the online application form carefully before final submission. If multiple applications are submitted, the one with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted. Ensure the highest RID application is complete in all respects.

6. Govt. Service Applicants: Candidates in Government Service must upload a copy of intimation submitted to their respective Head of Department or an NOC issued by the department along with the application form.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern

The mode of selection will be Computer Based Test (CBT) or OMR-based written screening test of 120 marks of 1½ hours (one and a half hours) duration or as decided by the Aayog.

The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, with each question carrying 1 mark.

Syllabus:

The CBT will cover two broad areas: (i) Subjects/fields up to the level of prescribed essential qualification(s) as notified in the advertisement; and (ii) (a) General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh and Current Affairs, and (b) Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English and General Hindi etc. of Matric Standard.

Qualifying Marks:

The minimum qualifying marks of written screening test/OMR/CBT shall be at least 45% marks for General category candidates and 40% marks for SC/ST/OBC/Ward of Freedom Fighters candidates. However, if the number of candidates securing the prescribed percentage is less than the number of advertised posts, the Aayog may relax the qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5%, i.e., up to 40% for General category and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/WFF candidates, for reasons to be recorded in writing.

In case of multiple shifts CBT examination, the score of candidates shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list.

Normalization Formula: Xn = (S2/S1) * (X - Xav) + Yav, where Xn is the candidate's normalized score, S2 is the SD of the shift with the highest average score (base), S1 is the SD of the corresponding shift, X is the raw score, Xav is the simple average of the shift, and Yav is the average of the base shift.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Terms of Engagement

Selected teachers will be engaged under the "Scheme for the Engagements of Teachers in Government Schools Affiliated to Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) on Fixed Honorarium/Consolidated Amount" (Annexure-I) notified by the Government of Himachal Pradesh, Department of School Education vide notification No. EDN-B-A(1)-3/2025 dated 01.04.2026. Key terms are as follows:

The engagement is purely temporary for a period of 5 years and is not against any sanctioned post of TGT/PGT/PRT. Teachers shall not be deemed to be Government employees in any manner. The fixed honorarium of ₹30,000/- per month is payable for 10 months in an academic year only and shall not be treated as salary. There is no right to regularization against any vacant sanctioned post. Service Rules including CCS/CCA/Leave Rules/Pension Rule applicable to Government servants shall not apply. Teachers will be entitled to 10 days Casual Leave and 5 days Medical Leave in a year. Teachers shall be eligible for Medical benefit schemes under HIMCARE/Ayushman Bharat if eligible. The selected candidates shall be liable to be posted anywhere within the State. The Government medical rules for reimbursement claims shall not be applicable to these teachers.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

Computer Based Test (CBT): Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit order in the CBT/OMR screening test of 120 marks conducted by the Aayog. No personal interview will be held.

Merit List & Waiting Panel: A category-wise merit list will be prepared based on marks secured in the CBT. In case of a tie, the merit will be determined on the basis of marks obtained in the essential qualification, then by age (senior preferred), and then alphabetically. A waiting panel shall also be prepared: up to 25 advertised posts - 25%; between 25 to 50 posts - 15%; above 50 posts - 10%, subject to minimum numbers. The waiting panel is valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation to the appointing authority.

Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates as per merit will be called for document verification. Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents and self-attested photocopies. The downloaded/printed copy of the online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be produced at the time of document verification. No Offline Application Form will be accepted.

Final Recommendation: After document verification, the Aayog will recommend candidates to the appointing authority. Recommendations of the Aayog will be valid till the appointments are offered to the candidates by the Appointing Authority.

Counseling/Allocation: After selection, allocation of schools/posts will be done through merit-based counseling as per Government guidelines.

How to Apply for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must submit their application online through the official website hprca.hp.gov.in. The candidate must be registered on the One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA. No Offline Application Form will be accepted by the HPRCA.

Step 1 - Sign Up: Visit the HPRCA portal https://hprca.hp.gov.in and click on the "Sign Up" option to create a username and password.

Step 2 - One-Time Registration (OTR): After successful sign-up, complete the One-Time Registration by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), uploading a recent photograph and signature, and uploading relevant supporting documents. This information is stored in the user's profile and can be utilized for future applications.

Step 3 - Complete/Update Profile: Only users who have completed their profile can apply for posts. If any updates are required (e.g., change in qualification or contact details), the candidate can edit their profile before applying.

Step 4 - Apply for a Post: Once the profile is complete, view the list of available posts on the HPRCA portal (https://hprca.hp.gov.in) and click on the "Apply" button corresponding to the desired post. Candidates are allowed to submit only one application form against each post.

Step 5 - Select Preferred Exam District: Select your preferred district(s) for the examination from the dropdown menu. Candidates may opt for three Test Cities from the list as per their preferences. MCL/HPRCA reserves the right to allocate any Test City. The same cannot be changed after the online form is submitted.

Step 6 - Confirm Application Details: The system will automatically fill your application form using the information from your profile. Please review all details carefully - including name, father's name, mother's name, date of birth (as per Matric Certificate), category, sub-category, age, essential qualifications, and scanned photograph (passport size, not older than one month, JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 1 MB) and scanned signature (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 1 MB) - before proceeding.

Step 7 - Pay Application Fee: Proceed to make the application fee payment of ₹800/- through the available Online Payment Gateway using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Step 8 - Application Submission Confirmation: After successful payment, your application will be considered complete. Take a printout of the online application form for future reference.

Correction Window: A correction window shall be opened for a period of four days commencing after the closing date for submission of ORAs. During this window, candidates shall be permitted to rectify errors in their ORAs subject to payment of ₹100/- correction fee through the prescribed payment gateway.

Note: The candidates must read the instructions carefully before filling up the ORA for the post(s) concerned. Incomplete ORA submitted without prescribed essential qualifications, age, date of birth, category, requisite examination fee and other processing fees, scanned photograph and signatures of prescribed size etc. will be rejected straightway. The candidates are strictly advised to apply online well in advance to avoid rush during closing dates.

Selection Process

Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test of 120 marks of 1 ½ hours (one and a half hours) duration or as decided by the Aayog.

Syllabus The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, with each question carrying 1 mark.

i) Subject(s)/field(s) upto the level of prescribed essential qualification(s) as notified in the advertisement. ii) (a) General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs. (b) Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi etc. of Matric Standard.

However, the HPRCA may issue a detailed syllabus on its official website in due course of time.

Minimum Qualifying Marks

  • General Category: 45%
  • SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters: 40%

If the number of candidates securing the prescribed percentage is less than the advertised posts, the Aayog may relax the qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5% (i.e., upto 40% for General and 35% for reserved categories) for reasons to be recorded in writing.

Normalization of Scores (for multiple shifts CBT) Scores shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list.

Further Process

  • Shortlisting for Document Verification based on merit.
  • Final selection/allocation on the basis of “Merit-Cum-Option-Cum-Availability of Post” formula.
  • Category-wise waiting list/panel shall be prepared (25%/15%/10% of posts as per rules).
  • Recommendations valid till appointments are offered by the Appointing Authority.
  • Selected candidates liable to be posted anywhere within the State.

How to Apply

Online Applications only – No Offline Application Form will be accepted.

Steps to Fill Up Online Application Form Step 1: Sign Up – Register on the HPRCA portal by clicking “Sign Up” to create username and password.

Step 2: One-Time Registration (OTR) – Complete OTR with:

  • Personal information
  • Educational qualifications
  • Work experience (if any)
  • Upload recent photograph & signature
  • Upload relevant supporting documents

Step 3: Complete/Update Profile – Only users with completed profile can apply. Edit if required.

Step 4: Apply for a Post – View available posts → Click “Apply”.

Step 5: Preferred Exam District – Select preferred district(s). (HPRCA reserves the right to allot any centre.)

Step 6: Confirm Application Details – System auto-fills from profile; review carefully.

Step 7: Pay Application Fee – Through Online Payment Gateway (Credit/Debit Card/Net Banking).

Step 8: Application Submission Confirmation – After successful payment, application is complete.

Important

  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling ORA.
  • Only one application per post. Multiple applications liable to rejection.
  • Correction window (4 days after closing date) – Fee ₹100/-.
  • Keep mobile number and email ID active till completion of selection process.

General Instructions

  • Date for determining eligibility = closing date i.e. 08.05.2026 (11:59 PM).
  • Age reckoned as on 01.01.2026.
  • Category certificates (OBC, BPL/EWS, WFF etc.) must be valid on both closing date and date of document verification.
  • Reserved category candidates of other States treated as General (UR).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates can avail scribe/reader + compensatory time (20 min per hour) after prior approval.
  • Examination & processing fee once paid non-refundable.
  • Provisional admission to CBT; final eligibility determined at document verification.
  • Admit Card downloadable from website only (no postal dispatch).
  • Candidates must bring downloaded ORA + original certificates at document verification.
  • No change in category claimed after correction window.
  • Meritorious reserved candidates considered only in their reserved category (not UR).
  • Waiting list valid for one year from date of recommendation.
  • Any dispute subject to Court jurisdiction of HP.
  • HPRCA reserves right to change terms, rectify errors, club posts, etc.
  • Selected teachers engaged purely on Scheme basis – temporary (5 years), fixed honorarium only, not Government employees, no regularization claim, service rules not applicable.
  • Candidates advised to visit https://hprca.hp.gov.in regularly for updates.

NPSC CESE 2026 Recruitment - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (30-05-2026). Only those candidates who possess the requisite qualification acquired from a recognized university/institution at the time of applying will be eligible. Merely registering or appearing in the examination does not make a candidate eligible. The post-wise minimum educational qualification requirements are as follows:

For Assistant Professors - Hr. Education Department: Master's Degree from a recognized University with at least 55% marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC). Candidates who have been awarded Ph.D. in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009 are exempted from NET/SLET/SET requirement. NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Degree Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET accredited test is not conducted.

For Assistant Professors - CTE (Hr. Education Department): Master's Degree from a recognized University with at least 55% marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC/differently abled candidates). Candidates applying for CTE posts must appear for separate Optional Papers as per the examination pattern.

For Lecturers - Technical Education Department: (i) Civil Engineering: B.E/B.Tech with minimum 60% aggregate or 1st Class. (ii) Electronics & Electrical Engineering: B.E/B.Tech with minimum 60% aggregate or 1st Class. (iii) M.Sc Physics/Chemistry/Mathematics/English with 60% (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST).

For Lecturers/WET/Research Associate (RA)/Training-Cum: Post Graduate with 50% Marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC category).

For PGT - School Education Department: Post Graduate with 50% Marks (relaxable by 5% for ST/SC/differently abled candidates).

The OTR (One Time Registration) starts from 12-05-2026 (Noon) and closes on 30-05-2026 (Noon). Candidates who have previously completed the OTR process may directly submit the online application. Candidates are requested to complete OTR at the earliest to avoid online traffic/complications due to last-minute submission.

Only those candidates with requisite qualification for CESE-2026 may register. Government employees must submit a "NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE" signed by the Head of the Department at the time of submission of the online application form. For any assistance/clarification, candidates may refer to FAQs from the Commission's website or call the Helpdesk No. +91 9402988506 on working days (10:00 AM to 03:00 PM). Any issues/complaints must be settled on or before the last date of submission - no issues/complaints will be entertained thereafter.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Reservation Criteria

SC/ST/OBC: Caste certificate issued by competent authority must be uploaded. OBC candidates must submit a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued between 01.04.2026 and 11.05.2026 (i.e., valid for financial year 2026-27) in the DoPT prescribed format. An additional declaration in Annexure-II must be submitted at document verification confirming non-creamy layer status.

EWS: Gross annual family income must be below ₹8 lakh for the financial year 2025-26. The family must not possess 5 acres or more of agricultural land, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, or a residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities. Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure-III format) must be issued between 01.04.2026 and 11.05.2026 by a competent authority (District Magistrate, Tehsildar, SDO, etc.). SC/ST/OBC candidates are not eligible for EWS reservation.

PwBD: Minimum 40% benchmark disability is required for fee exemption and age relaxation. Disability certificate from a government-authorized authority is mandatory. Scribe/Reader facility is available for eligible PwBD candidates (blindness, both-arm locomotor disability, cerebral palsy), subject to advance intimation via the online application. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of exam is allowed for scribe users.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process is conducted in two stages for a combined total of 100 marks:

Stage 1 - Computer Based Test (CBT): 75 Marks

  • Date: 22.05.2026
  • Duration: 50 minutes
  • Pattern: 50 objective-type questions × 1.5 marks each = 75 marks
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer
  • Syllabus: Based on prescribed educational qualification and professional course content for each post/speciality
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS; 35% for SC/ST/OBC

Stage 2 - Departmental Interview & Assessment: 25 Marks

  • Date (Expected): 23.06.2026
  • Based on clinical evaluation, laboratory testing, structured viva, or personal interview as applicable
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS; 35% for SC/ST/OBC

Candidates are shortlisted after CBT in the ratio of 1:3 (three candidates per advertised post), category-wise and department-wise. Eligibility notice will be published on 16.06.2026. Only candidates appearing in the Eligibility Notice will be called for document verification and interview.

Final Merit: Aggregate of CBT (75 marks) + Departmental Interview (25 marks) for candidates who qualify both stages separately.

Tie-Breaking (in order):

  1. Fewer wrong answers / less negative marking in CBT
  2. Date of birth (older candidate ranked higher)
  3. Higher aggregate percentage in 10+2
  4. Higher aggregate percentage in Matric/10th standard

Examination Centres: Chandigarh (Tricity), Delhi/NCR, Hyderabad, Kolkata. City preference is on a first-come-first-served basis and once allotted, cannot be changed.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.pgimer.edu.in and click on the Recruitment link on the Home Page.
  2. Register with mandatory details — name (as per matriculation), date of birth, mobile number, and email ID. Registration details cannot be changed once submitted.
  3. Log in using the User ID and password sent to your registered email and mobile number.
  4. Fill the Online Application Form section-by-section carefully. All entries are final on submission.
  5. Upload mandatory documents — educational certificates (from Matric onwards with mark sheets), MCI/DCI registration certificate, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), NOC from present employer (if applicable), and passport-size photograph.
  6. Pay the application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking.
  7. Take a printout of the final application form and e-Challan for future reference.

Photograph Instructions:

  • Clear passport-size colour photograph with light background in JPEG format, size 50-80 KB.
  • Must be taken on or after 01.03.2026.
  • Candidate's name and date of photograph must be written clearly on the photo.
  • No cap or goggles; spectacles are permitted.
  • Photo must be unattested on the application form.

Important: A candidate can apply for one department only. Applying for more than one department will result in rejection of all applications. No change in category or department is permitted after submission. Duplicate applications will be summarily rejected.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Documents Required at Document Verification

  • Printout of online application form
  • e-Challan (fee payment proof)
  • Educational certificates and mark sheets from Matric onwards
  • MCI/DCI registration certificate
  • Caste/category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD)
  • Fresh OBC certificate (issued from 01.04.2026 onwards)
  • OBC declaration (Annexure-II) — for OBC candidates
  • NOC from present employer (if currently employed)
  • All original documents corresponding to uploaded copies

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Likely Causes for Rejection

  • Applicant does not meet required qualification on the cutoff date
  • Required documents not uploaded with the application
  • Overage or underage on the closing date
  • Absence of visible identification mark in the application form

Engineering Mathematics Section 1: Probability and Statistics Random variables; Uniform, normal, exponential, Poisson and binomial distributions; Mean, median, mode, standard deviation; Conditional probability and Bayes theorem.

Computer Science & IT Section 3: Computer Organization and Architecture Machine instructions and addressing modes, ALU, data path and control unit; Instruction pipelining, pipeline hazards; Memory hierarchy (cache, main memory, secondary storage); I/O interface (interrupt and DMA mode).
Computer Science & IT Section 4: Analog and Digital Communication Autocorrelation and power spectral density; White noise filtering; Random signals through LTI systems; AM and FM modulation/demodulation; PCM, DPCM, digital modulation schemes (ASK, PSK, FSK, QAM); Error correction, Hamming codes; TDMA, FDMA, CDMA.
Computer Science & IT Section 5: Data Structures and Programming Arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, binary search trees, binary heaps, graphs; Programming in C, C++, Java; Recursion.
Computer Science & IT Section 6: Algorithms Searching, sorting, hashing; Asymptotic worst-case time and space complexity; Greedy, dynamic programming, divide and conquer; Graph traversals, minimum spanning trees, shortest paths.
Computer Science & IT Section 7: Compiler Design Lexical analysis, parsing, syntax-directed translation; Runtime environments; Intermediate code generation; Local optimization; Data flow analyses (constant propagation, liveness analysis, common subexpression elimination).
Computer Science & IT Section 8: Operating System System calls, processes, threads, inter-process communication, concurrency and synchronization; Deadlock; CPU and I/O scheduling; Memory management and virtual memory; File systems.
Computer Science & IT Section 9: Databases ER model, Relational model, relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL; Integrity constraints, normal forms; File organization, indexing (B and B+ trees); Transactions and concurrency control.
Computer Science & IT Section 10: Information Systems and Software Engineering Information gathering, requirement and feasibility analysis, data flow diagrams, process specifications, input/output design, process life cycle, planning and managing the project, design, coding, testing, implementation, maintenance.
Computer Science & IT Section 11: Computer Networks OSI and TCP/IP protocol stacks; Data link layer (framing, error detection, MAC, Ethernet bridging); Routing protocols; IP addressing, IPv4, CIDR, NAT; Transport layer (UDP, TCP, flow/congestion control); Application layer protocols (DNS, SMTP, HTTP, FTP, Email).
Computer Science & IT Section 12: Web Technologies HTML5, CSS3, XML; Client-server computing; Web server; Proxy server; Web application development; MVC Architecture; Web services; Frontend technologies.
Computer Science & IT Section 13: Cyber Security and Emerging Technologies Secure programming techniques; OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities; Concepts on IoT; Blockchain; AI.
Computer Science & IT Section 14: Cloud Technology Cloud Computing; Compute, Network, Storage Management Technologies; Edge Computing.

UCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess the minimum prescribed qualification mentioned against each trade as listed in the vacancy tables above. All mark sheets and certificates must be uploaded — a passing certificate alone will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting results/mark sheets are not eligible.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 years (minimum) and 25 years (maximum) as on 09 May 2026. Age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), PwBD, and other applicable categories will be as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation for SC/ST, EWS, OBC (NCL), and Physically Handicapped (PwBD) candidates shall be as per Government of India guidelines.

Priority / Preference in Selection

  • 1st Preference: Land Displaced Person (LDP) category candidates.
  • 2nd Preference: Local candidates from Project Affected Families (PAP) within 5 km radius of Tummalapalle unit (as per R&R Policy).
  • 3rd Preference: Wards of employees working in any unit of UCIL.

Hard copies for LDP and Employee Ward claims must be sent to the Personnel Section, UCIL Tummalapalle on or before the last date of application.

UCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Stipend

Stipend will be paid as per the rates prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992/2019/2025, as amended from time to time.

Employment Note: As per the Apprentices Act, 1961, it shall NOT be obligatory for UCIL to employ apprentices on completion of training. There is no provision for direct employment in UCIL on completion of apprenticeship training.

UCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

  • No application fee has been mentioned in the official advertisement. Candidates can register through the NAPS / NATS portal free of charge.

UCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be on a merit basis - based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination for the respective trade. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for document verification or reporting to the training location.

  • A provisional merit list will be prepared based on details entered in the online portal.
  • Physical verification of original documents will be done at the time of joining.
  • Results will be published on www.uraniumcorp.in. Selected candidates will be informed via their registered email ID.
  • Management reserves the right to cancel/modify/restrict the selection process without assigning any reason.

How to Apply for UCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the respective government portals. No offline or other mode of application will be considered.

  • Trade Apprentice: apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
  • Technician Apprentice (Diploma): nats.education.gov.in
  • Graduate Apprentice: nats.education.gov.in

1. Register on the portal: Visit the appropriate portal (NAPS for Trade Apprentice / NATS for Diploma & Graduate). Click on the Registration tab and complete registration. A confirmation email with an activation link will be sent to your registered email ID (e.g., Registration No. A000000000). Click the link to activate your account.

2. Complete your profile: Log in and fill in all personal, educational, and bank account details to confirm your registration. Ensure the Aadhaar-linked bank account details are accurate.

3. Upload required documents: Upload self-attested copies of — Matriculation certificate & all mark sheets, Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL only), EWS certificate (if applicable), Medical certificate (PwBD only), Photograph & signature, Aadhaar Card & PAN Card, Aadhaar-linked bank account details, Land Acquisition Certificate (for LDP) / Aadhaar Card for PAP family / UCIL ID card for employee wards.

4. Select Apprenticeship Opportunity: After registration, click on the Apprenticeship Opportunities tab. Select your desired trade and choose the unit: Uranium Corporation of India Limited, Tummalapalle, Andhra Pradesh. This must be done on or before 09 May 2026.

5. For LDP / Employee Wards: Send hard copies of the Land Displaced Person Certificate or Employee Ward Certificate (along with a self-attested copy of the UCIL employee ID card) by post to the Personnel Section, UCIL, Tummalapalle on or before the last date of application.

All previous applications submitted before the date of this advertisement will NOT be considered. Such candidates must apply afresh through the portal within the stipulated dates.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

5. Final submission: Review all entries carefully before final submission. After submission, no changes to mailing address, email ID, category, or post will be entertained. Keep registered mobile number and email active throughout the recruitment process.

APSC Class-I Home Guards Selection Process 2026

Stage Details
1. Written Examination Paper-I: General Ability & Intelligence Test – 200 marks, Objective (MCQ), questions in English; covers General Mental Ability, General Science, Current Events, Indian Polity & Economy, History of India, Indian & World Geography.

3. Medical Standards Test Medical Standards Test as per Assam Home Guards Service Rules, 2020 for candidates qualified in PET; appeals allowed within 15 days to Appellate Authority.
4. Interview / Personality Test Candidates declared fit in Medical Test will be called for Interview/Personality Test of 50 marks; provisionally for those awaiting Review Medical Board outcome.
5. Final Merit List Prepared based on marks obtained in Written Examination (Paper-I & II) and Interview/Personality Test.

  • Use a valid and active email ID and mobile number for registration and future communication.
  • Log in with registered email/mobile number and password, then fill in all mandatory details in the online application form.
  • Upload required documents: proof of Date of Birth, educational qualification certificates and mark sheets, caste/category certificates, BPL/PwBD certificates (if applicable) in PDF format (max 4 MB, scanned at 200 dpi, legible).
  • Upload recent passport-size Photograph and Signature (50 KB–200 KB each, photo not older than 3 months).

STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The official notification does not mention any application fee for applying for STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026. The online application through STPI's web portal (www.stpi.in) is free of cost. Similarly, registration on the NATS Portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) is also free. Candidates are advised to apply only through the official portals and not through any third-party website or agency. Be cautious of any individual or platform demanding a fee for application processing or selection facilitation - STPI does not charge any fee for this recruitment.

All Categories NIL (No application fee)

STPI Apprentice Trainee Stipend 2026

Selected Apprentice Trainees will receive a monthly stipend as per the qualification category. B.Tech/B.E. degree holders will receive Rs. 15,000/- per month, Diploma holders will receive Rs. 10,900/- per month, and B.A./B.Com degree holders will receive Rs. 12,300/- per month.

The stipend will be facilitated through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism - the Government's admissible share of the stipend will be directly credited to the apprentice's bank account through the NATS portal after successful DBT registration.

Candidates must ensure their bank account details (account number, IFSC code, bank name) are accurately entered during NATS portal registration, as any error may delay or prevent stipend disbursement. This is a training stipend and not a salary - no other allowances or service benefits are associated with the apprenticeship engagement.

Qualification Category Monthly Stipend Payment Mode
B.Tech / B.E. (Degree) Rs. 15,000/- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via NATS Portal
Diploma (Technical) Rs. 10,900/- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via NATS Portal
B.A. / B.Com Rs. 12,300/- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via NATS Portal

STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Stage Details
Stage 1: NATS Portal Registration Candidates must register on https://nats.education.gov.in and obtain a NATS Enrolment ID before applying. Bank details must be entered for DBT stipend processing.
Stage 2: Online Application on STPI Portal Apply online on www.stpi.in (Career Section) on or before 11/05/2026. Enter the NATS Enrolment ID in the application form.
Stage 3: Shortlisting Applications screened based on eligibility criteria - qualification, discipline, age, and NATS registration.
Stage 4: Interview Shortlisted candidates called for interview. Final selection based on marks obtained in the interview.

How to Apply for STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026

The application process is entirely online - only online applications through STPI's web portal will be accepted; no offline, postal, or email applications will be considered. Before applying on the STPI portal, candidates must mandatorily register on the NATS Portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) and obtain their unique NATS Enrolment ID, which is required to be entered in the STPI online application form.

Keep all educational certificates, identity documents, and bank account details ready before starting the NATS registration. After successful NATS registration, visit STPI's official website www.stpi.in, go to the Career Section, and complete the online application before 11/05/2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance and not wait until the last date to avoid technical difficulties.

  • Step 1: Register on the NATS Portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and obtain your unique NATS Enrolment ID (refer to Annexure A in the notification for step-by-step instructions).
  • Step 2: Visit STPI's official website www.stpi.in → Career Section.
  • Step 3: Fill in the online application form with all required details including the NATS Enrolment ID.
  • Step 4: Upload required documents as specified in the application form.
  • Step 5: Submit the online application on or before 11/05/2026.
  • Step 6: Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

NATS Portal Registration Guide for STPI Apprentice Trainee 2026

Registration on the NATS Portal (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme - https://nats.education.gov.in) is mandatory for all candidates before applying on the STPI portal. The NATS Enrolment ID generated after registration must be entered in the STPI online application - applications without this ID will not be accepted.

The stipend will also be processed through NATS via DBT, so accurate bank account details must be provided during registration. A step-by-step guide (Annexure A) is included in the official notification. The key steps are summarised below for quick reference.

Step Action Details
Step 1 Visit NATS Portal Go to https://nats.education.gov.in → Click on "Student" in the top menu bar
Step 2 Enrol as a Student Click "Enroll" under Student section → Read eligibility criteria → Click "Yes" if eligible → Proceed to Enrollment Form
Step 3 Fill Personal Information Enter name, date of birth, gender, email, mobile number → Create login ID and password → Enter Aadhaar number and other identification details
Step 4 Fill Educational Details Select highest qualification (Diploma / Graduate) → Enter institution name, year of passing, percentage/CGPA
Step 5 Fill Communication & Bank Details Enter present and permanent address → Enter bank account number, IFSC code, and bank name (for DBT stipend processing)
Step 6 Review and Submit Review all details carefully → Submit the registration form → Unique NATS Enrolment ID generated and sent to registered email ID

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Only online applications through www.stpi.in (Career Section) will be accepted.
  • NATS Portal registration at https://nats.education.gov.in is mandatory before applying on STPI portal.
  • Qualification must have been completed in April 2021 or thereafter.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship anywhere are not eligible.
  • Reservation as per Govt. of India rules: preference to 3-OBC, 2-SC, 1-ST out of 15 posts.
  • Stipend paid through DBT via NATS portal - ensure bank details are correctly entered during NATS registration.
  • Applications received after 11/05/2026 will not be considered under any circumstances.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Other Benefits

In addition to the consolidated monthly pay mentioned against each post, MECON offers a comprehensive benefits package to all contractual employees. Employees deployed at site/project locations receive a Site Allowance of 7.5% of pay, while those at Metro locations receive a Metro Allowance of 2.5% of pay. An annual increment on consolidated pay (rounded to the next ten rupees) is provided subject to company rules. Medical facilities including OPD and IPD treatment are available at Ispat Hospital, Ranchi, for employees posted at Ranchi (covering self, spouse, and 2 dependent children). For other locations, a company-retained doctor provides free consultation. Additionally, reimbursement of up to ₹15,000 per year towards Mediclaim premium (₹4,00,000 on floater basis) is available as per company policy.

Company accommodation (family or bachelor) may be provided based on availability at applicable charges; if not availed, HRA at 5% of consolidated pay is payable. Leave entitlements include Casual Leave (12 days/year), Earned Leave (18 days/year, accumulation up to 45 days), Half Pay Leave (14 days/year with commutation on medical certificate), and Maternity Leave as applicable to regular employees. National, Festival, and Restricted Holidays (4 nos.) are as per regular employee norms. All employees are covered under a Group Personal Accident Policy with a Sum Insured of ₹25 Lakhs.

Asst. Engineer (Civil) Full Time Diploma in Civil Engineering Min. 5 years in execution of civil works in industrial projects. 5

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit & Relaxation

The upper age limit for each post is 50 years for General (UR) and EWS category candidates, as calculated on the cut-off date of 23.03.2026. Age relaxation is provided as per Government of India guidelines. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates get a relaxation of 3 years, SC/ST candidates get 5 years, and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) get relaxation of 10 years (General), 13 years (OBC-NCL), or 15 years (SC/ST).

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Reservations & Relaxations

Reservations for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwD (Persons with Disability - 40% or above), and EWS candidates are provided as per Government of India guidelines. Reservation for PwD is on a horizontal basis. SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR category posts will be considered on General category merit - no age relaxation or fee waiver applies to them in such cases. OBC (NCL) candidates must produce a valid certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India; the certificate must not be more than 1 year old as on the date of advertisement. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority (such as District Magistrate, Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar rank, etc.) in the prescribed format available on MECON's website. The crucial date for the Income and Asset Certificate is the closing date for online applications.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying under UR, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), or EWS category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹500 (Rupees Five Hundred only). Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwD, or Ex-Servicemen categories, as well as internal MECON candidates, are fully exempted from paying any fee.

The application fee must be paid online through the payment gateway provided on MECON's official website. No other mode of payment (such as demand draft, postal order, or cash) is accepted. Once the fee is paid, candidates must click the "Verify" button to update the application status to "Submitted." Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates are strongly advised to verify their eligibility before making payment. Applications submitted without fee or with insufficient fee will be rejected.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Selection Mode

The selection process for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-In-Interview. Walk-In-Interviews will be conducted at four locations - Delhi, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Bangalore - and the specific dates and times will be published on the MECON Careers page. Candidates must apply online before appearing for the interview.

On the date of the Walk-In-Interview, document scrutiny will be undertaken; if any claim in the application is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA will be reimbursed. The final list of selected candidates will be published on MECON's website and communicated via registered email ID only. MECON reserves the right to change the mode of selection at its discretion.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Travelling Allowance (TA) for Interview

Outstation candidates who appear for the Walk-In-Interview are entitled to reimbursement of travelling allowance (TA) for to-and-fro travel by the shortest route from their mailing address (as mentioned in the application) to the interview venue. TA will be paid at III Tier AC (3A) / Chair Car (CC) rail fare rates, or ₹7 per km by road, whichever is less, subject to production of original tickets/receipts and/or boarding passes. Rail fare will be at regular (non-Tatkal/non-premium Tatkal) rates only. Internal MECON candidates will be governed by company service rules.

Candidates should note that scrutiny of applications is conducted on the interview date itself - if any claim is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. TA forms must be submitted along with proof of travel, bank account number, and IFSC code of the bank branch for payment processing.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Place of Posting

The initial place of posting for each post code is as listed in the table below. Post Codes 01 to 23 are for Rampura Agucha Mines / Debari, Rajasthan; Post Codes 24 to 25 for Bangalore, Karnataka; Post Codes 26 to 27 for Bacheli, Chhattisgarh; Post Code 28 for Ranchi, Jharkhand; Post Codes 29 to 35 for Malanjkhand, Madhya Pradesh; and Post Codes 36 to 60 for Burnpur, West Bengal. Candidates should note that the initial place of posting is indicative only - MECON reserves the right to post selected candidates at any project site, location, or office of the company based on organizational requirements. Candidates must be prepared for transfers/postings anywhere in India as per management discretion.

How to Apply for MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026

Applications for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through MECON's official website (www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online). No offline or postal applications will be accepted. Candidates must apply between 27 April 2026 and 11 May 2026. During the online application process, candidates must upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), a signature image in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), and self-attested PDF copies of all required documents.

If multiple documents need to be merged, they must be combined into a single PDF not exceeding 1 MB. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will result in summary rejection. No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application, so candidates must take utmost care before final submission.

Government/PSU employees must forward their application through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the time of the interview; failure to do so means they will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. Hard copies of the online application and all required documents must be brought on the date of the Walk-In-Interview.

Documents to be uploaded online:

  • Final/Provisional Graduation and Post-Graduation certificates (as applicable)
  • All semester/year-wise mark sheets or consolidated mark sheet
  • Work experience certificates/documents as per Para 6 of the notification
  • PAN Card and Aadhaar Card
  • Caste certificate - OBC (NCL) / EWS / SC / ST (as applicable; OBC certificate not more than 1 year old)
  • PwD certificate in prescribed Govt. of India format (if applicable)
  • Income & Asset Certificate for EWS candidates as per DoPT OM No.36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31.01.2019
  • Discharge/Service Certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • J&K Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
  • Meritorious Sportsperson Certificate (if applicable)

Important Instructions for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All documents must be self-attested; third-party attestation is not required unless specifically mentioned.
  • Original certificates/documents must be produced at the time of the Walk-In-Interview.
  • No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application.
  • Government/PSU employees must produce NOC from present employer at interview.
  • Certificates in languages other than Hindi/English must be accompanied by a certified translation.
  • Candidates must maintain a valid and active email ID and mobile number for at least 1 year - all future communications will be through email only.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only.
  • MECON's decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

Candidates must fulfil both the educational/technical qualification requirements and the age limit to be eligible for this recruitment. SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Selection Process 2026-27

The selection of candidates for Act Apprenticeship in SECR Raipur Division and Wagon Repair Shop, Raipur is based purely on merit, with no written examination. The merit list is prepared by taking the average of the percentage marks obtained in both the 10th (Matriculation) examination and the ITI examination, giving equal weightage to both (as per Railway Establishment Rule 201/2017).

The minimum eligibility score for 10th is 50% aggregate. Candidates who qualify in the merit list will be called for document verification, where all original certificates must be produced. If any discrepancy is found between the uploaded documents and originals, or if original documents are not produced, the candidature will be cancelled.

The Railway Administration's decision in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection is final and binding.

Basis Average of both (equal weightage)

Selected candidates appointed to the post of Data Entry Operator (DEO) at the Chhattisgarh High Court, Bilaspur will be entitled to pay as per Level-6 of the Chhattisgarh Government Pay Matrix. In addition to the basic pay, candidates will be entitled to all other allowances and benefits as per the rules applicable to State Government employees. Selected candidates after their joining will be kept on probation for the period as mentioned in the applicable rules.

Post Pay Level Pay Range (₹)
Data Entry Operator (DEO) Level-6 of Pay Matrix ₹25,300 – ₹80,500

Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Selection Process 2026

The selection process for Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Recruitment 2026 consists of two phases - Phase I Written Test and Phase II Skill Test. The examination is conducted through the Chhattisgarh Vyapam portal. Phase I Written Test is only a screening test; the merit list will be prepared exclusively on the basis of marks obtained in Phase II Skill Test, and the marks obtained in Phase I Written Test will not be considered for the preparation of the Merit List/Select List.

Candidates will be called for Phase II Skill Test in the ratio of 1:15 based on marks obtained in the Written Test. After receipt of the merit list (category wise - SC, ST, OBC, Male, Female and Divyang separately, and common merit list) from Vyapam, the High Court will publish the same on its website and document verification will be conducted at the High Court. After document verification, the select list and waiting list will be published on the official website of the Chhattisgarh High Court. In case of tie in marks in the Skill Test, the candidate born earlier will be placed above. If date of birth is also the same, preference will be given to candidates who have passed the Typewriting examination in Hindi and English from any recognised board.

Phase I - Written Test (100 Marks)

The Written Test consists of 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) divided into two sections. There shall be no negative marking in Phase I.

Section I: 60 Marks
Reasoning Quantitative Aptitude English General Studies & General Knowledge
15 Marks 15 Marks 15 Marks 15 Marks
Section II: 40 Marks - Computer
Unix/Open Source Software NT/Operating System, MS Windows & Ubuntu, Word Processing, Spreadsheet, PowerPoint, Access, Working with LAN, Antivirus, Network and Internet

Phase II - Skill Test (50 Marks)

The Skill Test consists of Hindi and English Typing Tests conducted in Ubuntu Linux – Libre Office – Unicode Font. A deduction of 1/4 mark will be made for each mistake. To qualify, the candidate must secure a minimum of 10 marks in each typing test out of 25.

Test Speed Requirement Marks
Computer Typing Test - Hindi 250 words in 10 minutes 25 Marks
Computer Typing Test - English 300 words in 10 minutes 25 Marks
Total   50 Marks

How to Apply for Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must apply online only through the official Chhattisgarh Vyapam website at https://vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in/. No other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must ensure they fulfil all the eligibility criteria before applying. Candidates should apply only if the conditions mentioned in the advertisement are acceptable to them. Candidates already in service must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of document verification; failure to produce NOC will result in rejection of candidature. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC) must submit a permanent Caste Certificate duly issued by the competent authority along with a certificate of residence of Chhattisgarh at the time of document verification. Reserved candidates (SC/ST/OBC) are also required to submit an affidavit at the time of joining in the proforma prescribed by the State Government with memo dated 29.06.2013, failing which their appointment shall be cancelled.

  • Visit the official Chhattisgarh Vyapam website at https://vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in/

  • Pay the application fee as per the prescribed mode on the Vyapam portal
  • Submit the application and retain a copy for future reference
  • Bring all original documents along with self-attested copies at the time of document verification

Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Application Form 2026

The online application form for Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Recruitment 2026 is available exclusively on the Chhattisgarh Vyapam portal at https://vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in/. Candidates are required to fill in their personal details, educational qualification details, category details, and other required information accurately in the online form. Candidates must ensure all details filled in the application match their supporting documents exactly, as any discrepancy found at any stage may result in cancellation of candidature.

Act.

Only those candidates who fulfil and accept all conditions mentioned in the advertisement should apply for the said post.
