Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT) only.

  • The CBT will comprise of objective type questions with multiple choice of answers. The Question Paper and instructions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi). However, in case of any error in Hindi version, the English version of the question shall be valid & final.
  • The CBT will consist of two sections (Section – ‘A’ & Section – ‘B’):
    • Section – ‘A’: Questions related to Technical Knowledge (Discipline related) with 80 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ).
    • Section – ‘B’: Questions related to General Awareness/Aptitude and Knowledge of CIL/SECL with 20 multiple choice questions (MCQ).
  • Each question will carry 1 mark and there is no penalty for wrong answer. No marks will be awarded for un-attempted questions.
  • Syllabus for the Computer Based Test (CBT) is attached as Annexure-A in the notification.
  • Selection of candidates in merit panel will be subject to securing of cut-off marks (Minimum Qualifying marks) in the Computer Based Test for concerned post with respect to their category as mentioned below and fulfilling prescribed eligibility criteria:
Category Qualifying marks in CBT
For General/EWS Candidates 45 marks
For OBC(NCL)/ESM Candidates 40 marks
For SC/ST Candidates 35 marks
  • Result of the Computer Based Test (CBT) will be published on SECL website as early as possible after successful completion of the CBT.
  • Provisional merit panels of candidates who secure the requisite cut-off marks and above and fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be published, in the order of marks scored, after resolving tie.
  • In case of tie of marks between 02 or more candidates, the merit-list will be prepared as per the following criteria: a) Date of Birth (As per the descending order of age of candidates) b) Seniority as per the Date of issue of Statutory Certificate c) In case still tied up, alphabetical order of the name of the candidates as recorded in the application form may be taken into consideration. d) In case still tied-up, the Selection Committee will decide the criteria for deciding the merit position of tied candidates.
  • Final merit panel will be prepared based on the marks obtained in the Computer Based Test.
  • Such candidates who would score equal or above the cut off (Minimum qualifying marks as provided in Table D) and as per vacancy available in each category, would only be notified for appearing for scrutiny/ verification of their testimonials supporting their claim of candidature, in order of their respective merit position drawn on the basis of marks scored in Computer Based Test (CBT) for different positions up to the extent the positions remain unfilled. The candidates shall have to appear along with all original certificates/ documents as per eligibility criteria notified in this Employment Notification for scrutiny/ verification. The date, time and venue for scrutiny/ verification shall be notified on SECL website and the candidates shall have to report accordingly. In the event of failure to report with all original certificates and testimonials within the stipulated time, the candidature of such candidate should stand cancelled.
  • Provisional Appointment Letter will be issued to the successful candidates in accordance with their relative merit position and with due consideration of the reservation of posts to the reserved category candidates and against vacancies.
  • If it is found during the Scrutiny/ Verification, or during the course of training, or even during the course of employment, that the candidate is not fulfilling the eligibility criteria in any respect, suppressing of facts or false declaration pertaining to his Employment/Caste/ Testimonials etc. then his/her candidature/ employment will be cancelled/terminated.

Note: In case, a candidate, selected for a particular post & declared as UNFIT during Initial Medical Examination, the case would be referred to Apex Medical Board of the Company within one month based on the written/physical representation and the decision of the Apex Medical Board will be final. If the Candidate is declared UNFIT by the Apex Medical Board, his/ her selection shall stand automatically cancelled. Such candidates will be communicated the decision of the Apex Medical Board as well as regarding cancellation of their selection.

2. How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through SECL website. No other mode (post, email, offline) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website of SECL https://secl-cil.in/ → Career → Employment Notification for Direct Recruitment of various Statutory posts → Apply online.
  2. Employment Notification is available in both English and Hindi. Candidates may select either of them at their convenience.
  3. While applying online, candidate needs to upload the scanned copies of:
    • Recent passport size colour photograph (not older than 3 weeks in jpg/jpeg format)
    • Signature with Black ink pen (in jpg/jpeg format)
    • Matriculation certificate or equivalent examination certificate or Degree or Diploma Certificate for the post of Mining Sirdar & Dy. Surveyor (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Matriculate or equivalent examination passed from any recognized Board of examination & Diploma or relevant and higher qualification (Minimum 3 years course) in Electrical Engineering from any Institute recognized by the Government, for the post of Assistant Foreman (Electrical) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Valid Caste Certificate OBC (NCL)/SC/ST candidates and Income Certificate for EWS Candidates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Ex-Servicemen Certificates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • PwBD Certificates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Competency certificate of Mining Sirdar/Surveyor (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Gas Testing & First Aid Certificate (for Mining Sirdar only) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
  4. Register by filling up necessary details (Post opted, name, Mobile No. and e-mail ID and click on Submit Button).
  5. Check the User ID and password received on your e-mail and mobile number after successful registration.
  6. Re-login to your account entering the User ID and Password received on Mobile No. and e-mail ID.
  7. Click on the option to go to application form and fill all the necessary details in the respective fields and upload all the required documents including Photograph and Signature.
  8. Check Preview of the Application Form and make corrections, if any.
  9. Press Submit Button and make Online Payment of the fees through Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking (as applicable).
  10. Keep the print out of the online application form filled for future references.

Application Fee:

Category Amount (₹)
Unreserved (UR) /OBC- (Creamy Layer & Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS ₹1000/- + GST ₹180/- = ₹1180/-
SC/ ST/ESM/PwBD/ Departmental Candidates/Female Candidates Nil

Note: Applications without the prescribed fee will not be entertained and summarily rejected. No representation against such rejection would be entertained. Fee once paid shall neither be refunded nor be adjusted under any circumstances. Any tax or Bank charges other than the application fees will be borne by the candidates. Application fee will be paid through online mode only.

General Instructions

  • Application should be submitted through ONLINE Mode only.
  • All qualifications should be recognized by AICTE / UGC / appropriate Indian Statutory Authorities.

He/ she may cross check the information such as Date of Birth, Category, Contact Details, and Qualifications etc. furnished in the application form before finally submitting the same online as no correction would be possible later and no correspondence will be considered in this regard.
  • The decision of SECL management regarding eligibility criteria, acceptance or rejection of applications, penalty for false information, mode of selection, selection and posting of selected candidates, will be final and binding on the candidates and no enquiry/correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • Mere issuance of Admit Card/ Call Letter to a candidate will not imply that his/ her candidature has been finally cleared by SECL. The candidature shall remain provisional till such time SECL verifies the eligibility conditions with reference to original documents after the candidate qualifies in the CBT and confirms appointment.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post for which they have applied. In case it is found at any stage of the selection process or even after the appointment that the candidate has submitted false or incorrect information or suppressed any relevant information/ material facts or does not fulfill the eligibility criteria, his/her candidature/ service is liable for rejection/ termination without notice.
  • No relaxation in the minimum educational qualification, as prescribed in Clause - '2' of this Employment Notification, is admissible for any category of candidate.
  • Wherever Grade (CGPA/ OGP/ DGPA etc.) is awarded, a certificate duly issued by concerned Board/University for conversion of Grade to percentage is to be produced by the candidate at the time of Scrutiny/ Verification of Original documents.
  • Age and all other eligibility criteria shall be reckoned as on the cut-off date as prescribed under this Employment Notification.
  • Candidates should carefully fill up their category (General/ SC/ ST/ OBC- Non Creamy Layer/ Ex-Servicemen/ EWS/PwBD etc.) in the Online Application Form. No change of category shall be allowed at the later stage of selection process.
  • Ex-servicemen must produce discharge certificate issued by Army/Navy/ Air Force of Indian Union at the time of document verification.
  • All documents (Caste Certificate, Educational Qualifications, EWS certificate, etc.) as per applicability and as provided by the candidate will be verified from the office of issuing authority and candidature will be cancelled if the certificates are not found satisfactory/ genuine at any subsequent stage of Computer Based Test (CBT).
  • The candidates must have an active E-mail Id & Mobile number which must remain valid for at least next one year. All correspondences with the candidates shall be done either through Speed Post/ Registered e-mail id & Mobile number (as may be necessary) and all general information shall be provided through SECL website. However, admit card will be provided only through SECL website and the candidates will have to download the admit card. The responsibilities of receiving, downloading and printing of application form, admit card and other information shall be of candidates. SECL will not be responsible for any loss of document due to invalid/ wrong/ incomplete contact details provided by the candidate or for delay/ non-receipt of information. In case of any problems faced by the candidates in filling up the online application they may refer the "Help Desk Option" available in the individual login portal. For queries other than the Online Application Form, candidates may write to Email Id: [email protected] only or can call us on 9425598240.
  • Candidates are advised to apply much before the closing date for submission of Online Application mentioned in this Employment Notification to avoid last minute network congestion.
  • SECL will not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications Online within the prescribed closing dates on account of any reasons beyond the control of SECL.
  • SECL reserves the right to shortlist candidates for Computer Based Test, reschedule the test date & venue etc. or alter any of the advertised condition depending upon the circumstances.
  • SECL will not bear any liability on account of service bond/ salary/ leave salary/ pension contribution, etc, if any, of previous employment of any candidate already working in Central Govt./ State Govt./ Autonomous Body/ Public Sector Undertaking.
  • Candidates employed in Govt./ Semi Govt./ Public Sector Undertaking (including departmental candidates) / Autonomous Bodies are required to produce 'No Objection Certificate' at the time of Scrutiny /Verification of original documents if shortlisted.
  • Selected candidates could be posted in any of the Mines/Establishments of SECL and are liable to be transferred to other subsidiaries of Coal India Limited any time during their service as may be required.
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to being found medically fit in the Company's Medical Examination as per the laid down Rules related to Medical Examination of CIL.
  • Selection of candidate shall be provisional, subject to verification of documents relating to eligibility criteria, character, antecedents and other documents submitted by the candidate and is also subject to his/ her meeting other requirements applicable for appointment under the rules of SECL.
  • Appointment of the candidate in SECL will be subject to verification of Character & Antecedents by the prescribed authorities and if any discrepancy / suppression is found, the candidature of the candidate will be cancelled and decision of SECL in this regard shall be final.
  • The date of Computer Based Test (CBT) and other details will be subsequently informed. Candidates will have to appear at the Centre/ Venue allotted to them by SECL for the Computer Based Test (CBT). No change in Centre/ Venue is permissible and no application shall be entertained in this regard.
  • SC/ ST candidates called for Computer Based Test (CBT) will be paid up to IInd Class Non-AC fare as per rules. However they have to submit their claims in duly filled appropriate TA Claim format provided at the examination centre along with all desired enclosures like caste certificate, photocopy of Onward (mandatory) and return Journey (optional) of railway ticket / bus receipt ticket to the room invigilator after attempting Computer Based Test (CBT) only, subsequent claims as well as claims with incomplete information will not be entertained. The distance of examination centre will be calculated from the Permanent address of the candidate or from place of actual journey whichever is shorter. In case, candidate has submitted only onward journey ticket and not submitted return journey tickets then the claims will be considered up to the double of onward journey fare and that will be paid as per rule.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the CBT, scrutiny/ verification of certificates and documents or for joining on being selected except otherwise as provided in this Employment Notification.
  • Candidate will appear for the CBT at the exam center at his/her owns risk and South Eastern Coalfields Limited will not be responsible for any injury or losses etc.
  • SECL management reserves the right to modify/ alter/ restrict/ enlarge/ cancel the recruitment process, and revise the number of vacancies, at its discretion without assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the SECL management will be final and no appeal will be entertained in this regard.
  • All future communication/ information regarding this recruitment will be made available on SECL website. Candidates are advised to check/ visit SECL website regularly for further updates.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be Honorable High Court of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur.
  • In case of any ambiguity/ confusion, English Version of Employment Notification will be considered valid.
  • Canvassing in any form will be treated as dis-qualification.
  • At the time of Computer Based Test (CBT), if a candidate is found guilty of using unfair means or impersonating or misbehaving in the examination hall or resorting to any other unfair means in connection with his/her candidature for the selection; or obtaining support of his/ her candidature by any means, such candidates will be liable to criminal prosecution and will be disqualified from the Computer Based Test (CBT). The Company may also debar such candidates from participating in any selection process in the Company in future.
  • If it is detected that any candidate has furnished any false information / particulars with regard to his/ her qualification, Category/caste and experience in the Application Form or in any document and/ or misrepresented / suppressed any material fact in the application form, for securing appointment, his/ her service will be terminated forthwith during probation period or even after confirmation of the service.
  • The Candidates whose postings are finalized after CBT, Verification and IME will be disqualified if they put external pressure for place of posting.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is ₹100 for General (UR), OBC, and EWS male candidates. Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen eligible for reservation are fully exempted from payment of fee.

Fee can be paid online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit Card. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be adjusted against any other examination. Candidates must ensure their fee payment is complete - if the fee is not received by SSC, the application status will show as "Incomplete" and will be summarily rejected.

General / OBC / EWS (Male) ₹100/-

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

The application process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is entirely online at https://ssc.gov.in. Candidates who have not yet completed their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website must do so first, as the earlier OTR from the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid for the new portal. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is available and recommended - candidates who opt for it will not face rejection on grounds of photograph or signature quality.

The application module is designed to capture a live photograph of the candidate through webcam or mobile device; pre-existing photographs must not be submitted. Candidates must also upload their scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB). Applications with blurred or miniature photographs or signatures will be summarily rejected unless Aadhaar authentication has been opted for. Only one online application per candidate is permitted during the normal application period.

  • Preview the application carefully, complete the declaration, and submit before 14.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card on or before 15.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process consists of two main stages: Shortlisting/Screening of applications followed by Field Trials for shortlisted candidates. In the first stage, applications will be screened against the eligibility criteria including educational qualifications, relevant sports experience, domain expertise, and suitability. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for Field Trials - the Bank may call candidates in a ratio as deemed appropriate at its sole discretion. The shortlisting criteria are internal and confidential and will not be shared with candidates.

Shortlisted candidates will be called for Field Trials at a designated venue, the evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off for which will be determined solely by the Bank. No requests for change of centre, venue, date, or time for Field Trials will be entertained. The Bank's decision on shortlisting and selection at all stages is final and binding. Selected candidates must be Active Sportspersons at the time of joining and fit enough to participate in future tournaments. All selected sportspersons will be required to sign a written undertaking to play for the Bank's team whenever required.

Stage Details
Stage 1: Shortlisting / Screening Applications screened based on eligibility criteria, sports experience, qualifications, and suitability as determined by the Bank. Criteria are internal and confidential.
Stage 2: Field Trials Shortlisted candidates called for Field Trials at designated venue. Evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off determined solely by the Bank.
Stage 3: Document Verification Original documents to be produced at the time of Field Trials / as called by the Bank. Failure to produce documents will debar candidature.

Misconduct Refusal to play for the Bank or playing elsewhere without permission will be treated as misconduct and attract disciplinary proceedings.
Written Undertaking All recruited sportspersons must give a written undertaking at the time of appointment.

The application process is entirely online - no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must visit the Bank's official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and apply through the Careers → Current Opportunities section. Before starting the application, candidates must ensure they have a valid personal email ID and active mobile number, a scanned passport-size photograph (20–50 KB, JPG format), a scanned signature in black ink on white paper (10–20 KB, JPG format), and scanned PDF copies of all required documents within the specified file sizes (maximum 500 KB per file).

Candidates are advised to fill the application with utmost care as no changes will be permitted after clicking the SUBMIT button. All details including name, caste, category, date of birth, mobile number, and email ID will be treated as final. Candidates must not submit more than one application; in case of multiple submissions, only the last valid completed application will be retained and fees for earlier applications will be forfeited. A printout of the system-generated application form and e-receipt should be retained for future reference.

ITBP Assistant Commandant (Engineer) Application Fee 2026

The application fee must be paid online only through the payment gateway available at the official ITBP recruitment website. Payment through any other mode will not be accepted and applications submitted with alternate payment modes will be summarily rejected. The fee once paid is non-refundable under all circumstances, including in the event of cancellation of notified vacancies.

SC/ST candidates, Ex-Servicemen, and female candidates are fully exempted from the application fee. Candidates are advised to complete the payment process carefully and retain the payment confirmation for their records.

ITBP Assistant Commandant (Engineer) Selection Process 2026

The selection process for ITBP Assistant Commandant (Engineer) is comprehensive and multi-staged, designed to assess physical fitness, academic knowledge, and overall personality. All stages are qualifying/evaluative, and candidates must clear each stage to proceed to the next. The process begins with a Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), followed by a Written Examination (two papers), Document Verification, a Personal Interview/Personality Test, Detailed Medical Examination (DME), and finally a Review Medical Examination (RME) for those declared unfit in DME.

The final merit list is prepared based on combined marks of the Written Examination and Interview. Biometric enrolment is mandatory at the PST/PET stage and may be verified at any subsequent stage. Candidates must carry a clear printed copy of their online application form and admit card to enter the PST/PET venue.

Stage-wise Selection Process:

Stage Details
1. Physical Standard Test (PST) Height, Chest, Weight as per prescribed norms
2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Qualifying in nature - all events must be independently cleared
3. Biometric Identification Mandatory at PST/PET; verified at all subsequent stages
4. Written Examination Paper-I (MCQ/CBT) - 100 marks, 2 hours; Paper-II (Subjective) - 100 marks, 2 hours
5. Document Verification Original documents checked by Board of Officers before interview
6. Interview (Personality Test) 50 marks - Knowledge, Experience, Personality, GK, Extra-curricular
7. Merit List Based on combined marks of Written Exam + Interview
8. Detailed Medical Examination (DME) Conducted as per MHA/ADG (Med) CAPFs guidelines
9. Review Medical Examination (RME) Available for candidates declared unfit in DME, on written consent within 24 hours

General Awareness 10
Extra-Curricular Activities (Sports/NCC) 10

How to Apply for ITBP Assistant Commandant (Engineer) Recruitment 2026

The application process is entirely online through the official ITBP recruitment website. Candidates must fill the online application form carefully after reading all instructions. A genuine and functional email ID and active mobile number must be provided during registration, as all communications including admit cards will be sent through these channels.

All information filled in the form - including gender, category (UR/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS), and employment status - must be accurate and complete, as any false or incorrect information will lead to cancellation of candidature with no option for change at later stages. In-service candidates working in Central/State Government, Autonomous Bodies, PSUs, or Statutory Bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) in original as per Annexure-V from their employer at the time of document verification; failure to produce NOC will result in summary rejection of candidature. Candidates are strongly advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

Candidates must read the complete notification carefully before applying and ensure they satisfy all eligibility conditions. All disputes will fall under the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble Courts within the territorial limits of Delhi only. For queries or clarifications, candidates may contact via email at [email protected]

NIA Scientific Posts Deputation Recruitment 2026: Get the latest National Investigation Agency (NIA) recruitment notification 2026 inviting nominations for 30 Scientific posts on Deputation (ISTC) basis under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India. Posts include Technical Forensic Psychologist, Finger Print Expert, Explosive Expert, Cyber Forensic Examiner, and Crime Scene Assistant. Nominations are to be submitted within 60 days from the date of publication in Employment News. Find NIA vacancy details on the official website www.nia.gov.in.     • For Constable (Driver, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Gardner, Painter, Carpenter, Brass Band, Pipe Band, Cobbler, Tailor & Bugler): Male – 5 Kms race in 24 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 8.30 minutes.
    • For Constable (Cook/Water Carrier, Barber & Hair Dresser, Washer man & Washer women, Safai Karmachari): Male – 1.6 Kms in 10 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 12 minutes.
    • For Pioneer Wing (Mason / Electrician): Male – 1.6 Kms in 09 minutes.
    • Pregnant women candidates will be declared temporarily unfit.
  • Physical Standards Test (PST): Height, Chest (for males only) & Weight (proportionate to height & age).
    • Height: Male – 170 Cms (minimum); Female – 157 Cms (minimum). Relaxations applicable for certain categories (ST, NE States, Gorkhas, etc.).
    • Chest (Male only): Un-expanded – 80 Cms, Minimum expansion – 05 Cms. Relaxations applicable.
    • Candidates failing PST will be eliminated.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 marks (100 MCQs), duration 02 hours.
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • General Knowledge & General Awareness – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Elementary Mathematics – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • English/Hindi – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
    • Qualifying marks: UR – 30%, EWS/OBC – 25%, SC/ST & others – 20%.
    • Marks will be normalized. Merit list prepared on CBT marks.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Qualifying in nature (50 marks, minimum 20 marks required). Practical assessment of the applied trade/post.
  • Document Verification (DV): Original documents (Matric certificate, Domicile/PRC, Trade certificates, Caste/EWS/ESM certificates, etc.) will be verified.
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): As per Uniform Guidelines issued by MHA. Temporary unfitness allowed only for pregnancy. Final selection subject to medical fitness.
  • Final merit list prepared on the basis of marks obtained in CBT (subject to qualifying all stages). Separate merit lists for male/female and each State/UT (All India basis for Pioneer posts).

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through CRPF website. No other mode will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website www.rect.crpf.gov.in.
  2. Click on the link for “Recruitment for the post of Constable (Technical & Tradesmen and Pioneer) 2026”.
  3. Register by providing basic details and generate Provisional Registration Number & Password.
  4. Fill the online application form carefully (personal details, educational qualification, trade/post applied, State/UT of domicile, etc.).
  5. Upload scanned copies of recent colour passport size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) through BHIM, UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card or CSC Wallet.
  7. Submit the application and take printout of the application form & e-receipt for future reference.
  8. Candidates should bring two coloured printouts of the Admit Card at every stage of examination.

UP Assistant Professor B.Ed. Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit & Pay Scale

Age Limit: The maximum age of applicants as on 31.08.2022 must not exceed 62 years. Applications will not be submitted if date of birth is not mentioned or the candidate is above 62 years on 31.08.2022.

Pay Scale: ₹15,600 - ₹39,100 with Grade Pay of ₹6,000, along with allowances as permitted by the state government from time to time.

UP Assistant Professor B.Ed. Recruitment 2026 - Educational Qualification

The essential qualifications for the post of Assistant Professor/Assistant Acharya B.Ed. are as follows (as per NCTE Regulations 2014 and UP government order):

Option 1:

  • Postgraduate degree in Science / Mathematics / Social Science / Humanities with minimum 55% marks
  • AND M.Ed. with minimum 55% marks

OR

Option 2:

  • Postgraduate degree in Science / Mathematics / Social Science / Humanities with minimum 55% marks
  • AND Postgraduate degree in Education (M.A. Education) with minimum 55% marks
  • AND B.Ed. degree or equivalent with minimum 55% marks

Additionally (for both options):

  • National Eligibility Test (NET) in Education conducted by UGC

OR

  • Ph.D. or D.Phil. in Education from a University that has obtained the degree in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations 2009/2016

UP Assistant Professor B.Ed. Recruitment 2026 - Reservation Rules

Only candidates who are original domicile residents of Uttar Pradesh are eligible for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Freedom Fighter Dependent/PwBD reservation benefits. Candidates from other states will be treated as General (UR) category. Key rules include:

  • Candidates claiming more than one reserved category will be given only one concession — whichever is more beneficial.
  • For OBC reservation, the candidate's parents/family must normally reside in UP and the individual or their family should belong to UP's listed OBC categories.
  • Female candidates' caste certificate based on their husband's caste (for SC/ST) will not be accepted; only the caste certificate based on the father's side will be valid.
  • PwBD (Physically Handicapped) candidates must produce a certificate issued by the competent authority specifying the percentage of disability.
  • EWS candidates must ensure their Income & Asset Certificate is issued in the prescribed format on or before the application closing date.
  • Government employees must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer before applying. The NOC need not be submitted initially but must be produced at the time of interview.
  • Candidates married to a person who already has a living spouse are not eligible unless exempted by the Governor.

UP Assistant Professor B.Ed. Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection is based on two stages — Written Examination and Interview:

Written Examination (200 Marks):

  • Objective-type question paper covering General Knowledge (60 questions) and Subject-specific questions (140 questions)
  • Total marks: 200 (General Knowledge: 60 marks + Subject: 140 marks; each question carries 2 marks)
  • Total: 30 General Knowledge questions + 70 Subject questions = 100 questions
  • No negative marking
  • The syllabus for the subject-specific test is available on the UPSSSC portal under the "Examination" section

Interview / Assessment (30 Marks):

  • Candidates shortlisted based on written exam scores will be called for departmental interview and assessment

Final Merit: Written Exam (200) + Interview (30) = 230 marks total

Candidates scoring equal aggregate marks in the merit list will be resolved by giving preference to the older candidate (by date of birth).

Preference (Adhimanta) for College Allotment: At the time of interview, shortlisted candidates must submit their online preference/priority order for college allotment. The order of preference given by the candidate is binding. Male candidates must not indicate women's colleges in their preference order; doing so will make them personally responsible for any resulting discrepancy. Female candidates may indicate preference for both types of colleges.

UP Assistant Professor B.Ed. Recruitment 2026 - Instructions for Reserved Category Candidates

  • Visually impaired candidates can avail Scribe facility as per UP government order no. AI0/210789/2022/65-3099/135/2022 dated 08 September 2022. The scribe's educational qualification must not exceed Intermediate level. Candidates using a scribe will be given 40 minutes of extra time. Candidates who need a scribe must register with the commission office at least one week before the exam.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Main Written Examination followed by Physical Standards Test and Physical Efficiency Test (qualifying in nature).

  • Shortlisting for Main Examination: Based on normalized score of Preliminary Eligibility Test-2025 (PET-2025). Only candidates who have qualified PET-2025 with valid Score Card can apply. Candidates securing zero or negative marks in PET-2025 will not be shortlisted.
  • Main Written Examination: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (Objective Type), 2 Hours duration.
    • Negative Marking: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
    • Minimum qualifying marks will be decided by the Commission.
    • Syllabus:
      • Part-1 (85 Marks): History of India & Indian National Movement, Geography of India & World, Economic & Social Development of India, Indian Polity & Constitution, General Science & Technology, Environmental Ecology & Disaster Management, Current Events of National & International Importance, Data Interpretation, Important Legal Provisions & Policies related to Excise in Uttar Pradesh.
      • Part-2 (15 Marks): Knowledge of concepts of Computer & Information Technology and contemporary technological development & innovation in this field.
  • Physical Standards Test (Qualifying):
    • Male: Height 167.6 cm, Chest 80 cm (unexpanded) / 85 cm (expanded).
    • Female: Height 152 cm (General), 147 cm (SC/ST), Weight 45 kg.
  • Physical Efficiency Test (Qualifying):
    • Male: 4.8 km run in 25 minutes.
    • Female: 2.4 km run in 14 minutes.
  • Final selection is based on marks obtained in the Main Written Examination. Physical tests are qualifying in nature.
  • Result of Main Examination and final merit list will be declared on the official website.

UPSSSC AGTA Selection Process 2026

The UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises shortlisting on the basis of UPSSSC PET 2025 scores, a mains written examination and document verification. Only PET 2025 qualified candidates will be allowed to appear in the UPSSSC AGTA mains exam.

Stage 1 – Shortlisting through UPSSSC PET 2025

  • Candidates must have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard to apply for the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C mains examination.
  • UPSSSC will prepare a list of eligible candidates for AGTA mains based on PET 2025 scores, reservation rules and post‑wise vacancy distribution.
  • Only shortlisted candidates, as per the criteria given in the official notification, will be permitted to fill the UPSSSC AGTA mains online form and appear for the written exam.

Stage 2 – UPSSSC AGTA Mains Written Examination 2026

  • The mains written exam for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant Group C will be an objective type paper covering agriculture and related subjects as per the prescribed syllabus.
  • The question paper will carry a fixed number of questions and marks (details like total marks, duration and negative marking will be as per the official AGTA notification).
  • Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks and rank high in the merit list to be considered for the next stage of the selection process.

Stage 3 – Document Verification

  • Candidates shortlisted on the basis of performance in the AGTA mains written exam will be called for document verification (DV).
  • During DV, candidates must produce original documents and certificates related to age, educational qualification, category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), domicile, PET 2025 score, and other eligibility criteria.
  • Failure to produce valid documents or any discrepancy in information can lead to cancellation of candidature for UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026.

The final selection list for UPSSSC AGTA Recruitment 2026 will be prepared purely on the basis of marks obtained in the mains written examination, subject to successful document verification and fulfilment of all eligibility conditions.

How to Apply for UPSSSC AGTA / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026

The application process for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Only candidates who have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 registration and score can fill the UPSSSC AGTA online form 2026 on the official website upsssc.gov.in.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission at upsssc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: On the home page, click on the “Notifications/Advertisements” section and open the link for Advt. No. 06-Exam/2026 – Technical Assistant Group C (AGTA) Recruitment 2026.
  • Step 3: Read the UPSSSC AGTA Notification 2026 carefully, then click on the “Apply” or “Candidate Registration” link given against the advertisement.
  • Step 4: Log in using your UPSSSC PET 2025 Registration Number, date of birth and other required details; the system will fetch your basic data from the PET database.
  • Step 5: Fill the UPSSSC AGTA online application form 2026 with category, educational qualification, agriculture degree details, reservation information and other required fields.
  • Step 6: Upload your recent passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as mentioned in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C notification.
  • Step 7: Pay the UPSSSC AGTA application fee of ₹25 (for all categories) using the available online payment options such as net banking, debit/credit card, SBI I‑Collect or e‑challan.
  • Step 8: Review all the details entered in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C application form carefully, then submit the form and take a printout of the final submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

Candidates should complete the UPSSSC AGTA Online Form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.

Educational Qualification (Post-wise):

Assistant Treasury Accountant (Directorate of Treasury): Bachelor's Degree from a university established by law in India or equivalent qualification recognised by the Government, as per UP Treasury Accountant (Non-Gazetted) Service Rules, 2019, Part-4, Rule-8.

Account Inspector (Cooperative Societies & Panchayat): Bachelor's Degree from a university established by law in India, as per UP Subordinate (Cooperative Societies and Panchayat) Accounts Audit Service Rules, 2025, Part-4, Rule-8.

Amin/Auctioneer (State Agriculture Mandi Parishad): Bachelor's Degree from any recognised university, as per UP Agriculture Production Mandi Samiti (Centralised) Service Rules, 1984 as amended, Rule-7.

Executive Officer (Municipal Administration): Bachelor's Degree from a recognised institution as per U.P.0 Municipal Centralised Service Rules, 1966 as amended. Clerk-cum-Typist / Cashier-cum-Clerk / Account Clerk (Agriculture Mandi Parishad): Bachelor's Degree from any recognised university, as per UP Agriculture Production Mandi Samiti (Centralised) Service Rules, 1984 as amended, Rule-7.

Assistant Consolidation Officer / Assistant Revenue Officer (Office of Consolidation Commissioner): Bachelor's Degree from a university established by law in India, as per UP Land Consolidation Service Rules, 1992 as amended, Part-4, Rule-8. Candidates with a Law Degree (LLB) from any university will also get preference in direct recruitment.

Assistant Promoter (Non-Technical) – General/Special Selection (Industries & Enterprise Promotion Directorate): Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification recognised by the Government, as per UP Industry Department Subordinate Service Rules, 1992, Part-4, Rule-8.

Centre In-Charge (UP State Road Transport Corporation): Bachelor's Degree from a university established by law in India or equivalent qualification recognised by the State Government, along with working knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script, as per UP State Road Transport Corporation Service Rules, 1981 as amended, Part-4, Rule-18.

District Assistant Training Officer (Family Welfare Mahadirectorate): Candidates must have passed the Intermediate Board Examination of UP with Biology and Mathematics subjects and hold a Bachelor's Degree from any recognised university, as per Government Order No. 2859/5-10-2004-JI-137/2004 dated 10 September 2004.

Mandi Inspector Grade-2 (State Agriculture Mandi Parishad): Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks and Intermediate with at least 50% marks from a recognised university (for General/Unreserved candidates). SC/ST/OBC candidates need at least 45% in both Graduation and Intermediate.

Preferential Qualification (All Posts): Preference will be given to candidates who have served in the Provincial Armed Forces (Pradeshik Sena) for a minimum of 2 years, or who have obtained the 'B' Certificate of the National Cadet Corps (NCC), all other conditions being equal.

Age Limit: Generally 21 to 40 years as on 1st July of the year in which recruitment is advertised. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-Servicemen, Freedom Fighter Dependants, PwBD, Women, Outstanding Sportspersons and Departmental Candidates as per UP Government rules and the specific service rules applicable to each post.

Note: For EWS category candidates, the EWS certificate must be issued between 01 April 2026 and 18 June 2026 (last date of application), based on income of financial year 2025-26 and valid for financial year 2026-27. UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services (Graduate Level) Recruitment 2026 selection will be based on a Written Main Examination (Likhit Pariksha).

Main Examination (Written Test – 100 Marks, 2 Hours): There will be one question paper containing 100 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks with a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). There is negative marking of 1/4 (25%) of prescribed marks for each wrong answer.

The examination paper will be divided into three parts as follows:

Part Subject No. of Questions Total Marks
Part-1 History of India & Indian National Movement 05 05
  Indian Polity & Indian Constitution 10 10
  Geography of India & World 05 05
  Indian Economy & Social Development 10 10
  General Science 05 05
  Environment, Ecology & Disaster Management 10 10
  Current Events of National & International Importance 05 05
  General Intelligence Test 05 05
  Elementary Mathematical Knowledge 05 05
  General Hindi 05 05
Part-2 Knowledge of Computer & IT Concepts, Contemporary Technological Development & Innovation 15 15
Part-3 General Information related to the State of Uttar Pradesh 20 20
  Total 100 100

Shortlisting for Main Exam: Candidates will be shortlisted for the Main Examination based on their normalised score in PET-2025, taking 15 times the category-wise vacancies (up to the final cut-off score, rounded to 2 decimal places).

How to Apply for UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates for UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services Recruitment 2026 must apply online through the official UPSSSC portal before the last date.

Step 1 – Login via PET-2025 Registration Number: Visit upsssc.gov.in and login using your PET-2025 Registration Number and OTP sent to the registered mobile number/email. Only PET-2025 registered candidates can apply.

Step 2 – Select Posts and Fill Application: Your personal details from PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. Select the post(s) you wish to apply for, verify eligibility, and fill in all educational qualification, community, and other details carefully.

Step 3 – Enter Post Preference: In the "Other Details" section, enter your post and department preference priority and indicate preferential/additional qualification details (if applicable).

Step 4 – Verify Photo and Signature: Your photo and signature uploaded in PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. No changes can be made. Click Continue to proceed.

Step 5 – Pay Application Fee: Pay Rs.25/- via Credit Card, Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or SBI e-Challan. After successful payment, your application form will be auto-submitted. Download and print the application form immediately.

Step 6 – Fee Reconciliation & Amendment: If required, reconcile fee and amend permissible details (correspondence address, EWS/horizontal reservation category, educational qualification, marital status) on the Applicant's Dashboard by 25 June 2026. Save a printout of the final application for future reference.

UPSSSC Block Organizer, Platoon Commander Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed Graduation (Bachelor's Degree) from any recognized university. For Block Organizer / Platoon Commander posts under Home Guards Headquarters, UP, the mandatory educational qualification as per UP Home Guards Service Rules 1982, Part-4, Rule-8 is a Graduate degree from a recognized university (for non-departmental/civilian category).

Desirable Qualification (Adhimani Arhat): As per UP Home Guards Service Rules 1982, Part-4, Rule-9, preference will be given to candidates who have: (a) served in a Provincial Army for up to two years, OR (b) obtained NCC 'B' certificate, OR (c) continuously worked in the Home Guards organization for a minimum of three years.

Age Limit: Candidates must be between 21 years and 40 years as on the first day of January of the year of recruitment (as per the advertisement date). Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories as per UP government norms.

Reservation: SC/ST/OBC/EWS vacancies are reserved as per Uttar Pradesh government reservation rules. 3% of vacancies are reserved for Physically Handicapped (Divyang) candidates. Reservation for women, ex-servicemen, freedom fighters' dependents and outstanding sportspersons is also applicable as per applicable UP government rules.

UPSSSC Block Organizer, Platoon Commander Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern

UPSSSC Block Organizer, Platoon Commander Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for UPSSSC Block Organizer and Platoon Commander Recruitment 2026 consists of the following stages:

Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted for the Main Written Examination based on their normalised score in the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET-2025). Only candidates who appeared in PET-2025 and have been issued a score card by the commission are eligible to apply for the Main Examination.

Main Written Examination (Likhit Pariksha): Selection will be based on the written examination consisting of 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks in 2 hours (120 minutes) with negative marking of ¼ mark per wrong answer.

Physical Measurement Test: Qualifying in nature; candidates must meet the prescribed physical standards.

Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature; candidates must complete the prescribed run within the specified time.

Final Merit List: Will be prepared based on marks obtained in the Main Written Examination by candidates who qualify the physical tests.

Step 2 - Select Post: In the application section, select the post(s) you wish to apply for and confirm your educational qualification details.

UPSSSC Forest Guard Selection Process 2026

  • Read the Declaration carefully, select all checkboxes, enter the verification code, and click the "Save and Submit" button.
  • Pay the prescribed application fee through Credit Card, Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or SBI e-Challan as per instructions given on the website.
  • After successful fee payment and reconciliation, download and print your application form and keep it safe for future reference.

Only one application per candidate will be accepted; in case of multiple applications, only the last submitted application will be considered. Candidates must download and print their application form after successful fee payment.

Apply Online at: upsssc.gov.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates are advised to read all instructions issued by UPSSSC carefully before applying for Forest Guard and Wildlife Guard Recruitment 2026. Non-compliance with any of the instructions may result in outright rejection of the application or disqualification (DEBAR) from future examinations and selections conducted by UPSSSC. The key instructions are listed below.

  • All candidates belonging to reserved categories of Uttar Pradesh must mandatorily mention their category in the application form.
  • Candidates claiming reservation/age relaxation under more than one reserved category will be given only one relaxation — whichever is more beneficial.
  • Candidates who are not domiciles of Uttar Pradesh are not eligible for reservation benefits; such candidates will be treated as Unreserved (UR).
  • EWS category candidates must possess a valid EWS certificate issued between 01-04-2026 and 20-07-2026 (based on income for FY 2025-26, valid for FY 2026-27).
  • Divyang (Persons with Disability) candidates must update their disability category/sub-category in the application form as per the latest UP Government orders.
  • Ex-Servicemen who will have been discharged from military service by 20-07-2026 are also eligible to avail reservation benefits under the applicable Act.
  • Outstanding sportspersons of Uttar Pradesh must produce the certificate issued by the competent authority as per the prescribed format to avail reservation benefits.
  • No individual correspondence will be made by the Commission with any candidate; all information is uploaded on the official website upsssc.gov.in only.
  • Candidates who are in Central or State Government service must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer before participating in the selection process.
  • Any act of misconduct, use of unfair means, or malpractice during the examination will result in cancellation of candidature and may lead to DEBAR from all future examinations and selections by UPSSSC.
  • Male candidates who have more than one living wife are not eligible to apply; similarly, a female candidate who has married a person who already has a living wife is not eligible, unless exempted by the Governor.

Open Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Application Link

  • Find and click on the notification/link titled “CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026” or similar.

  • Click on the Apply Online button to proceed to the application page.

  • Enter basic details such as Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Date of Birth, and create a password.

  • Submit the details to generate your Registration ID and Password (note these for future login).

  • Login using your Registration ID and Password.

  • Fill in the online application form carefully with personal details, contact details, educational qualification, Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator certificate details, and preferred state/district.

  • After successful payment, download/print the fee receipt.

Final Submission

  • Carefully review all the details filled in the application form in the Preview section.

  • If required, make corrections before final submission.

  • Click on Final Submit to complete the application process.

Print Application Form

  • After successful submission, download and take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

  • Keep the Registration ID, Password, and printout safe for further recruitment stages.

Online submission of application can only be made from the link provided on the official FRI website at https://fri.icfre.gov.in. AIIMS Rishikesh Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Professor - Medical Candidates: A medical qualification included in Schedule I, II, or Part II of the Third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 along with a postgraduate degree such as MD/MS or equivalent in the respective discipline. For surgical super-specialties, M.Ch. is required; for medical super-specialties, D.M. is required (2, 3, or 5-year recognized course). Experience required: 14 years after MD/MS, or 12 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course after MBBS), or 11 years after a 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Master's degree + Doctorate degree from a recognized university + 14 years of teaching/research experience after obtaining the doctorate.

Additional Professor - Medical Candidates: Same basic qualifications as Professor (Medical). Experience: 10 years after MD/MS; for super-specialty disciplines, 8 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course), or 7 years after 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 10 years of experience after the doctorate.

Associate Professor - Medical Candidates (General Disciplines): Same as Professor (Medical) + 6 years of experience after MD/MS. For super-specialty disciplines, 4 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course), or 3 years after 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 6 years of experience after the doctorate.

Assistant Professor - Medical Candidates (General Disciplines): Same as Professor (Medical) + 3 years of experience after MD/MS. For super-specialty disciplines, 1 year after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course after MBBS); no experience required for candidates with 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 3 years of experience after the doctorate.

Hospital Administration Department: A medical qualification under Schedule I & II or Part II of the Third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, along with MD in Hospital Administration or a Master's Degree in Hospital Administration (MHA) from an MCI recognized institution. Experience varies by post: 14 years (Professor), 10 years (Additional Professor), 6 years (Associate Professor), or 3 years (Assistant Professor) after obtaining the postgraduate degree.

How to Apply for Fakir Mohan University Faculty Recruitment 2026

Candidates must follow the two-step application process (Online + Hard Copy Submission) carefully. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

  1. Register and Fill Online Application Form Visit the official recruitment portal at https://himsrecruitment.odisha.gov.in and register using a valid email ID and mobile number. Fill all the required personal, educational, experience, and research details accurately in the online application form. Candidates must ensure that all information provided matches their original documents.
  2. Upload Scanned Documents Upload clear scanned copies of all essential documents including:
    • Matriculation/SSC certificate (proof of date of birth)
    • Master’s Degree marksheets & certificate
    • Ph.D. Degree & certificates
    • NET/SET/SLET certificate (if applicable)
    • Experience certificates
    • Caste / SEBC / PwD certificate (if claiming reservation)
    • Research publications, API / Research Score details (for Professor & Associate Professor)
    • Recent passport-size photograph and signature. All documents must be in the prescribed format and size as mentioned on the portal.
  3. Pay Application Fee Online Pay the non-refundable application fee through the online payment gateway available on the portal:
    • ₹1000/- for General / SEBC candidates
    • ₹600/- for SC / ST candidates
    • No fee for PwD candidates Keep the payment receipt / transaction ID for future reference.
  4. Submit Online Application and Take Printout After successful payment, review the preview of the application form, make corrections if any, and finally submit it. Download and print the completed online application form. Note down the Application / Registration Number generated by the system.

Send the complete set through Speed Post / Registered Post only to: The Registrar, Fakir Mohan University, Vyasa Vihar, Balasore – 756089, Odisha The envelope must be superscribed with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________________ (Subject & Post)” along with Advertisement Number.
  6. Last Dates & Important Instructions
    • Last date for submission of Online Application: 7th June 2026
    • Last date for receipt of Hard Copy with documents: 17th June 2026 (up to 05:00 PM) In-service candidates must route their application through proper channel or submit NOC from their present employer. OPSC Civil Judge Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for OPSC Civil Judge Recruitment 2026 consists of 3 successive stages — Preliminary Written Examination, Main Written Examination, and Interview as per the provisions of the Orissa Superior Judicial Service & Odisha Judicial Service Rules, 2007 (as amended from time to time).

Candidates must clear the minimum qualifying marks at each stage to proceed to the next. The final merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in the Main Written Examination and Interview combined. Candidates securing equal aggregate marks will be ranked based on Main Written Examination marks; if equal still, then LLB examination marks; if still equal, the older candidate shall be placed above.

The list recommended by the Commission shall remain valid for one year from the date of its approval by the Government.

Paper Type Marks Duration
Single Paper (Objective MCQ) OMR-based, 100 questions of 1 mark each; negative marking of 25% for every wrong answer 100 1 hour 30 minutes

Preliminary Exam Syllabus: Constitution of India; Code of Civil Procedure, 1908; Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023; Indian Evidence Act, 1872 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023; Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023; Limitation Act; Transfer of Property Act; Law of Contract; Law of Succession (Indian Succession Act and Hindu Succession Act); Specific Relief Act; Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005; and any other relevant topics as the High Court of Orissa may specify from time to time.

Stage 2 – Main Written Examination

Optional Paper V Jurisprudence and the Constitution of India Descriptive 150 3 Hours

OPSC Civil Judge Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

Preliminary Written Examination (100 Marks, OMR MCQ, 1½ Hours, Negative marking 25%):

The paper covers the Constitution of India; CPC 1908; CrPC 1973 and Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023; Indian Evidence Act 1872 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023; IPC 1860 and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023; Limitation Act; Transfer of Property Act; Law of Contract; Law of Succession; Specific Relief Act; Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005; and any other relevant legal topics as specified by the High Court of Orissa from time to time.

Main Written Examination – Paper 1 (General English, 150 Marks): Translation and retranslation of ten lines each (one passage English to Odia and one Odia to English); Short Essay of about 150 words; Precis writing of 300 words; one passage of about 500 words with 5 questions.

Main Written Examination – Paper 2 (Procedural Laws, 150 Marks): Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 and Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023; Code of Civil Procedure 1908; Indian Evidence Act 1872 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023.

Optional Papers (150 Marks each – candidate to choose any 3): Law of Crime & Law of Torts; Personal Laws (Hindu Law and Mohammedan Law); Law of Property (Transfer of Property Act, Specific Relief Act, Indian Limitation Act); Law of Contract (Indian Contract Act, Sales of Goods Act, Partnership Act, Negotiable Instrument Act); Jurisprudence and the Constitution of India.

Document Verification: Based on the merit order of marks secured in CBT, shortlisted qualified candidates in the ratio of 1:3 will be called for document verification. In case of a tie in marks, it will be resolved on the basis of Date of Birth (elder candidate first) and thereafter Name alphabets. Candidates must appear with all original certificates/documents and photocopies as per eligibility criteria. Candidates working in Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/CIL & Subsidiaries must produce a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer.

Provisional Select List: After verification of documents/certificates, a Provisional Select List of successful candidates will be published on the official website of MCL (https://mahanadicoal.in).

Final Appointment: Provisionally selected candidates will be issued an offer of appointment based on their position in the merit list and with due consideration of reservation policy of Govt. of India for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS/ESM. The validity of the merit panel will be for 01 year or as per extant Govt. guidelines.

Medical Fitness: Selected candidates will have to undergo Initial Medical Examination (IME) in the designated Hospital by the Company's Doctor. Final appointment/joining will be subject to being declared medically fit as per rule. Minimum required height of the candidate should be 60 inches (excluding for the post of Asst. Foreman (Electrical) (Trainee), T&S Gr-C only in case of Dwarfism).

IREL OSCOM Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection will be based on merit determined by marks scored in the specified educational qualification. In case of a tie in marks, the candidate with higher marks in the qualifying examination will be preferred. If the tie persists, seniority in date of birth (older candidate preferred) will be the tiebreaker. No canvassing or influencing will be acceptable - this will result in rejection of the candidature.

Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification in the order of merit and must bring original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies. Final engagement is subject to satisfactory medical fitness as certified by IREL's Medical Officer. Reservation is as per the Government of Odisha guidelines. A unique priority-based selection system also applies to give preference to local, land-affected, and IREL employee-related candidates.

Priority IV Candidates who are permanent residents of villages beyond 07 km but within a radius of 10 km from OSCOM Unit
Priority V Candidates who are domicile of Odisha State (documentary proof required)
Priority VI Candidates from Rest of India

Stage 2: Hard Copy Application Submission Fill prescribed application proforma (printed back-to-back on A4 paper), affix passport-size photograph, attach all required self-attested documents, and send by Speed Post/Courier to reach IREL OSCOM on or before 15th May 2026.
Stage 3: Merit-based Shortlisting Based on marks in qualifying examination. Priority categories applied. Tiebreaker: higher marks → date of birth (older preferred).
Stage 4: Document Verification Shortlisted candidates called in merit order. Original documents + self-attested photocopies required. Provisional Offer Letter sent by email. Candidature rejected if originals not produced or eligibility not satisfied.
Stage 5: Medical Examination Candidates must be declared "Medically Fit" by IREL's Medical Officer. Final engagement subject to satisfactory medical fitness.
Stage 6: Police Verification Mandatory Police Verification Certificate from concerned police authorities (of area where candidate normally resides) - must be submitted prior to joining, as OSCOM is a highly protected area.

Applications without online portal registration will not be accepted, and online registration alone without hard copy submission is also insufficient.   • Engineering Mechanics, Building Construction, Building Materials, Construction of Sub/Superstructure, Building Finishes & Maintenance, Building Drawing, Concrete Technology, Surveying, Computer Aided Design (AutoCAD), Geo-Technical Engineering, Hydraulics, Irrigation Engineering, Mechanics of Structures, Theory of Structures, Design of Concrete Structures, Design of Steel Structures, Transportation Engineering (Railway Engineering), Highway Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Advanced Construction Techniques, Estimating & Costing, Contracts & Accounts.

Electrical & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Basic Concepts, Circuit Law, Magnetic Circuits, AC Fundamentals, Measurement Instruments, Electrical Machines (DC/Transformers/Induction Motors), Synchronous Machines, Generation, Transmission & Distribution, Estimation & Costing, Utilisation of Electrical Energy, Basic Electronics.

Electronics & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Electronic Components & Materials, Electronic Devices & Circuits, Digital Electronics, Linear Integrated Circuits, Microprocessor & Microcontroller, Electronic Measurements, Communication Engineering, Data Communication & Networks, Computer Programming (C/C++), Basic Electrical Engineering.

Mechanical & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Engineering Mechanics, Material Science, Strength of Materials, Machining, Welding, Grinding & Finishing, Metrology, Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery, Industrial Management, Thermal Engineering.

PGT Written Examination Syllabus

  • Mathematics: Number Systems, BODMAS, LCM/HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Mensuration, Time & Work, Simple & Compound Interest, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Statistics, Pipes & Cistern.
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Series, Coding-Decoding, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation, Analytical Reasoning, Directions, Statement-Arguments etc.
  • General Awareness: Current Affairs, Indian Geography, Culture, History, Indian Polity & Constitution, Indian Economy, Environment, Sports, Science & Technology.
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences (up to Class 10 CBSE syllabus).
  • Professional Ability (50 questions): Education (22-28 Q) - Philosophy, Sociology, Human Values, Democracy, Integration; Psychology of Learner & Teaching (13-18 Q); Curriculum and Instruction (8-12 Q).

How to Apply for CLW GDCE 2026

This is an offline application process meant exclusively for regular CLW employees. There is no online application portal.

1. Download Application Format: Obtain the application form in Annexure-C format as enclosed with this notification (GDCE 01/2026 dated 10.04.2026). Affix one recent self-attested photograph in the space provided.

2. Fill the Application Form: Enter all details accurately - Name (in capitals), Date of Birth, Age as on 09.04.2026, Designation & Ticket No., HRMS ID & Employee No., Date of initial appointment & grade, Educational Qualification, Date of appointment to present grade, Post(s) applied for, Community (UR/SC/ST/OBC), PwBD status, Mobile number, and Email address.

3. Get Controlling Authority Signature: The completed application must be forwarded by the controlling authority - obtain the signature of the controlling supervisor with designation, and the counter signature of the controlling officer with office seal. The Establishment Officer must also certify the particulars from the Service Book.

4. Attach Required Documents: Enclose self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC), PwBD certificate (if applicable), and any other relevant documents.

5. Drop Application in Drop Box: Submit the filled and forwarded application by dropping it in the Drop Box at the Recruitment Section, Personnel Department, Administrative Building, Chittaranjan - 713331 by 08 May 2026 (17:30 hrs). No application will be accepted after the deadline under any circumstances.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Additional Assistant Director: The post is to be filled on deputation basis. The eligibility criteria including educational qualification, experience, and other conditions are detailed in Annexure-C, available on the CBIC website (www.cbic.gov.in) and DGPM website (https://dgpm.gov.in).
  • The Directorate General of Performance Management is the cadre control authority in respect of Group 'B' and 'C' cadres including the post of Additional Assistant Director in various Directorates under CBIC.
  • These Directorates deal with functions such as investigations into cases of evasion of duties/taxes, human resource development, infrastructure, audit, inspections, legal and appellate matters, systems and data management, and data analysis.
  • Candidates whose applications are forwarded by the concerned Ministry/Department/Organization once received in DGPM will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected officers under DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 will be placed at Pay Matrix Level-8 (Rs. 47,600–1,51,100) on deputation basis.
  • After completion of four years of regular service in Level-8, officers will be placed at Level-9 (Rs. 53,100–1,67,800) in the pay matrix.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Application Process

  • The nomination/application process for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is through offline/hard copy mode only via the proper channel. Eligible officers must get their nominations forwarded by their concerned CCAs (Chief Controllers of Accounts) along with NOC and all required documents.
  • Applications/Documents received through e-Office of concerned CCAs will be accepted only where the same are duly received in hard copy. Applications/Documents received only through email will not be accepted.
  • The nominations of eligible officers along with required documents, duly attested in Hard Copy, must reach by post or special messenger to:
  • Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12th May 2026 (by 5:00 PM).

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is a deputation-based recruitment. Selection will be based on the eligibility criteria as per Recruitment Rules of Additional Assistant Director dated 31.03.2022 of DGPM.
  • The selected officers may be posted to any of the Directorates/Stations throughout India. Applicants may give the option of 05 Directorates in Annexure B(i) and 03 Stations in Annexure B(ii) in order of their preference. However, the options exercised do not guarantee posting at the said Directorate/Station.

How to Apply for DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible officers for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 must submit their nominations through proper channel well before the closing date.
  • Step 1 – Check Eligibility: Download and read Annexure-C from www.cbic.gov.in or https://dgpm.gov.in to verify eligibility criteria, educational qualification, and experience requirements.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Application: Fill in the application/nomination form with personal details, service details, cadre information, posting preference (5 Directorates from Annexure B(i) and 3 Stations from Annexure B(ii)), and all required information.
  • Step 3 – Obtain NOC: Obtain No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your employer/department before forwarding the application.
  • Step 4 – Forward Through Proper Channel: Get the nomination forwarded through the concerned CCA (Chief Controller of Accounts) with all required documents duly attested in hard copy.
  • Step 5 – Ensure Hard Copy Reaches on Time: Ensure the complete application in hard copy reaches Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12 May 2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date or incomplete in any respect will not be entertained.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Other Benefits

In addition to the consolidated monthly pay mentioned against each post, MECON offers a comprehensive benefits package to all contractual employees. Employees deployed at site/project locations receive a Site Allowance of 7.5% of pay, while those at Metro locations receive a Metro Allowance of 2.5% of pay. An annual increment on consolidated pay (rounded to the next ten rupees) is provided subject to company rules. Medical facilities including OPD and IPD treatment are available at Ispat Hospital, Ranchi, for employees posted at Ranchi (covering self, spouse, and 2 dependent children). For other locations, a company-retained doctor provides free consultation. Additionally, reimbursement of up to ₹15,000 per year towards Mediclaim premium (₹4,00,000 on floater basis) is available as per company policy.

Company accommodation (family or bachelor) may be provided based on availability at applicable charges; if not availed, HRA at 5% of consolidated pay is payable. Leave entitlements include Casual Leave (12 days/year), Earned Leave (18 days/year, accumulation up to 45 days), Half Pay Leave (14 days/year with commutation on medical certificate), and Maternity Leave as applicable to regular employees. National, Festival, and Restricted Holidays (4 nos.) are as per regular employee norms. All employees are covered under a Group Personal Accident Policy with a Sum Insured of ₹25 Lakhs.
