MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

Employment Type Required Documents

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Reservations & Relaxations

Reservations for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwD (Persons with Disability - 40% or above), and EWS candidates are provided as per Government of India guidelines. Reservation for PwD is on a horizontal basis. SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR category posts will be considered on General category merit - no age relaxation or fee waiver applies to them in such cases. OBC (NCL) candidates must produce a valid certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India; the certificate must not be more than 1 year old as on the date of advertisement. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority (such as District Magistrate, Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar rank, etc.) in the prescribed format available on MECON's website. The crucial date for the Income and Asset Certificate is the closing date for online applications.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying under UR, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), or EWS category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹500 (Rupees Five Hundred only). Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwD, or Ex-Servicemen categories, as well as internal MECON candidates, are fully exempted from paying any fee.

The application fee must be paid online through the payment gateway provided on MECON's official website. No other mode of payment (such as demand draft, postal order, or cash) is accepted. Once the fee is paid, candidates must click the "Verify" button to update the application status to "Submitted." Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates are strongly advised to verify their eligibility before making payment. Applications submitted without fee or with insufficient fee will be rejected.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Selection Mode

The selection process for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-In-Interview. Walk-In-Interviews will be conducted at four locations - Delhi, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Bangalore - and the specific dates and times will be published on the MECON Careers page. Candidates must apply online before appearing for the interview.

On the date of the Walk-In-Interview, document scrutiny will be undertaken; if any claim in the application is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA will be reimbursed. The final list of selected candidates will be published on MECON's website and communicated via registered email ID only. MECON reserves the right to change the mode of selection at its discretion.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Travelling Allowance (TA) for Interview

Outstation candidates who appear for the Walk-In-Interview are entitled to reimbursement of travelling allowance (TA) for to-and-fro travel by the shortest route from their mailing address (as mentioned in the application) to the interview venue. TA will be paid at III Tier AC (3A) / Chair Car (CC) rail fare rates, or ₹7 per km by road, whichever is less, subject to production of original tickets/receipts and/or boarding passes. Rail fare will be at regular (non-Tatkal/non-premium Tatkal) rates only. Internal MECON candidates will be governed by company service rules.

Candidates should note that scrutiny of applications is conducted on the interview date itself - if any claim is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. TA forms must be submitted along with proof of travel, bank account number, and IFSC code of the bank branch for payment processing.

How to Apply for MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026

Applications for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through MECON's official website (www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online). No offline or postal applications will be accepted. Candidates must apply between 27 April 2026 and 11 May 2026. During the online application process, candidates must upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), a signature image in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), and self-attested PDF copies of all required documents.

  • Post Grade: Rajpatrit II Shreni (Gazetted Class II).
  • Post Status: Temporary (Asthaayi).
  • Employment Registration:
    • Candidates from other states are exempted from registration in Employment Exchange as per High Court order dated 08.03.2022 in Writ Petition No. 5096/2022.
    • MP domicile candidates' live Employment Exchange registration is not required at the time of application, but must be submitted by the last date of document submission before the interview.
    • MP domicile candidates serving in Government or Non-Government service are exempt from Employment Exchange registration on production of No Objection Certificate (Government employees) or Service Certificate (Non-Government employees).
  • All qualifications must be completed on or before the last date of application i.e. 20.05.2026.

Salary / Stipend

  • Pay Scale: ₹15,600 – ₹39,100 Per Month
  • Grade Pay: ₹5,400/-
  • Post Grade: Rajpatrit II Shreni (Gazetted Class II)
  • Other allowances as applicable per Government rules for Madhya Pradesh State services.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Minimum Age: 21 Years
  • Maximum Age: 40 Years
  • Age is computed as on 01 January 2027.
  • Only the date of birth as recorded in the 10th (High School) marksheet will be accepted. Candidates must mention the same name, father's name, and date of birth in the online application as in their High School marksheet.
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC/ST/OBC/Divyangjan/Government Employees/Nagar Sainik/Women (Unreserved/Reserved): 5 years relaxation in upper age limit as per MP Government order Saa.Pra.Vib. No. Ci.3-8/2016/1/3 dated 04 July 2019.
    • Ex-Servicemen: Age reduced by length of defence service; resultant age must not exceed upper age limit by more than 3 years.
    • Intercaste married couple (Anusuchit Jati-Savarna) under Promotion Scheme: 5 years.
    • Vikram Puraskar awardee sportspersons: 5 years.
    • In no case should the maximum age exceed 45 years after all relaxations.

All Other Categories (General/UR) and candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh ₹500/-

  • Late Application Fee (after 28.05.2026 to 28.10.2026): ₹25,000/- additional.

Selection Process

  • Written Examination (OMR Based):
    • Objective type questions on OMR sheet will be conducted.
    • Negative Marking (Rnnatmak Mulyankan) is applicable.
    • Exam centres: Indore, Bhopal, Jabalpur and Gwalior.
    • Exam Plan and Syllabus will be published on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in in due course.
    • Candidates up to a maximum of three times the notified vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for interview based on written exam marks.
  • Interview (Viva Voce / Saakshaatkar):
    • Candidates shortlisted from the written examination will be called for interview.
    • Interview total marks: 100. Minimum qualifying marks for Unreserved category: 41; for Reserved categories and Divyangjan: 31.
    • Final selection will be based on the merit order of aggregate marks (written examination + interview).
    • Candidates absent from interview will be considered ineligible for selection.
  • If total applicants are less than 500: Selection will be based on interview only. Candidates will be shortlisted directly for interview as per the following ratio: 1 post – up to 12 candidates; 2–3 posts – up to 24; 4–6 posts – up to 36; 7–9 posts – up to 48; 10 posts and above – up to 50 candidates or 5 times the vacancies.
  • Post-Answer Key Process: Provisional answer key will be published on the Commission's website after the exam. Objections can be submitted within 05 days at ₹150/- per question (plus ₹40/- portal charge). Final answer key will be published after expert committee review. No objections will be entertained after publication of the final answer key.

General Information / Instructions

  • All amendments/instructions issued by the Government from time to time regarding age, domicile, employment exchange registration, reservation etc. will be incorporated into the final selection result.
  • The syllabus is attached in Bhaag-"H" of the notification and will be published on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in.
  • Cut-off marks of written exam and interview will not be disclosed prior to final selection.
  • If a computer or clerical error is noticed after declaration of result, the Commission reserves the right to correct it.
  • Reserved category seats (SC/ST/OBC) and age relaxation benefits are available only to Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates. Candidates from other states will be considered as Unreserved.
  • In any reserved category, if no eligible female candidate is available, the reserved seats will be filled by male candidates of the same category.
  • Divyangjan (Persons with Disabilities) candidates must attach the latest valid disability certificate issued by the District Medical Board constituted as per Ministry notification F-8-1-Satreh-Medi-2, dated 09.01.2009. Disability certificate issued after 01.06.2021 must be from the UID portal http://www.swavlambancard.gov.in. Manually issued certificates after that date will be invalid. Minimum 40% permanent disability is required to claim reservation and other benefits.
  • Candidates who are in Government service (temporary, daily wage, contractual, or under public undertakings) must submit an Undertaking that they have informed their Head of Department/office about applying for this post.
  • All information published regarding this recruitment notification including result will be available only on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Commission will not communicate through Email/letters/phone individually.
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Section) certificate valid for financial year 2026-27 must be held by the candidate by the last date of online application i.e. 20.05.2026.
  • OBC candidates must ensure they are not in the Creamy Layer. Non-Creamy Layer declaration as per the prescribed proforma must be submitted.
  • Final selection result for OBC reservation is subject to the pending court cases SLP 8764/2023 and WP5596/2024 and related matters. The result will be declared in Main Part (87%) and Provisional Part (13%) as per MP Govt. order dated 29.09.2022.
  • Disqualifications under MP Civil Services Rules 1961: Candidates convicted of crimes against women, candidates with more than 2 living children (where one was born on or after 26 January 2001) are not eligible for appointment.

How to Apply

  • Online applications must be submitted at www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Applications through any other means will not be accepted.
  • Online application window: 21-04-2026 to 20-05-2026.
  • Before filling the form, prepare a recent passport-size colour photograph scan and signature scan file as per instructions in the notification.
  • Fee can be paid via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or at M.P. Online authorized kiosks in cash.
  • After filling the form, a popup window will display basic information (name, parents' names, date of birth, category, gender) for verification. If any error is found, click Cancel to go back and correct. Click OK to submit. After successful submission, the application number will be generated (status will be Unpaid until fee is paid).
  • After submitting, click "Proceed for Payment" to complete fee payment. After successful payment, the application will be received and "Payment Done" will be displayed. Take a printout of the application form and preserve the application number for future reference.
  • Error Correction Facility: Online application correction can be done from 26.04.2026 to 22.05.2026 (till 12:00 midnight) at ₹50/- per correction. Applications submitted with late fee: corrections allowed up to 28.10.2026 at ₹50/- per correction.
  • Category/Gender/Date of Birth cannot be changed after the error correction period ends.
  • Candidates must ensure their signature is consistent across all documents; mismatch of signatures on various documents will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • No documents need to be uploaded at the time of online application. However, before the interview, attested self-certified documents must be submitted to the Commission as per the detailed checklist in Annexure/Parishisht-01 of the notification.
  • For any query or complaint regarding online application filling: Helpline – 0755-6720220; Email – [email protected].

MP ESB Hospital Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for MP ESB Hospital Assistant Recruitment 2026 consists of a single-stage Online Written Examination (Computer-Based Test) of 100 marks with 100 objective MCQ questions to be answered in 2 hours. The exam will be conducted in Hindi and English medium. Results will be prepared on the basis of the Percentile score (Normalised Equi-Percentile / NEP scaling technique) when the examination is held in multiple shifts.

The merit/panel list will be prepared category-wise based on the percentile score obtained by candidates. If candidates score equal percentile, the tie will be resolved first by proportionate marks, then by age (older candidate preferred). The waiting list (Pratiksha Suchi) will consist of 15% of the selected candidates' count and will remain valid for one year from the date of result declaration or until a new result is declared, whichever is earlier.

Application Fees

The advertisement does not mention any application fee; applications are invited online through the NATS portal as per Apprenticeship rules.

Age Limit

The notification specifies academic year conditions for Degree/Diploma passing but does not explicitly give an age limit; eligibility is tied to year of passing.

Key points:

Eligibility

Basic Eligibility

  • Candidates must be Degree or Diploma holders in the relevant Engineering branches or Graduates in General Stream as specified.

  • Candidates must have passed in 2024, 2025, or 2026 only; those who passed in 2023 or before are not eligible.

  • Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training elsewhere will not be considered.

Training Period & Other Conditions

  • Duration of apprenticeship is 1 year for all apprentices.

  • IPR has no obligation to offer regular employment after completion of training, and apprentices cannot claim any right to permanent employment on the basis of apprenticeship.

  • Accommodation facility will not be provided; candidates must arrange their own stay.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be purely on merit based on percentage of marks in the respective Degree/Diploma in Engineering/Non-Engineering.

SGGU Godhra Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for SGGU Godhra Self-Finance College Recruitment 2026 consists of 4 stages - Online Application, Interview, Document Verification, and Merit-based College Allocation. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview at their own expense at the date, time, and venue specified on the university website. After the merit list is prepared, candidates and college management authorities will be summoned to the university and candidates will be offered different college options based on their merit. The selected candidate will receive the appointment letter from the respective college on the same day.

Stage Details
Stage 1 – Online Application Submit application through Samarth Portal via official SGGU website before the last date.
Stage 2 – Interview Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview at their own expense. Date, time, and venue will be notified on the university website.
Stage 3 – Document Verification Candidates must bring Hard Copy of the online application form along with all original certificates and self-attested copies for verification at the time of interview.
Stage 4 – Merit List & College Allocation After merit list preparation, candidates and college authorities are called to the university. Candidates are offered different college options based on merit. Appointment letter issued by the respective college on the same day.

Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (01-06-2026). Only unmarried Indian citizens are eligible to apply. Candidates must have minimum 60% marks in English in Class X or Class XII. Foreign university degrees are also accepted if the institution is recognised by the Government of India or holds an Engineering Degree equivalence certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU Act 1973).

Candidates in the final year of their qualifying degree (regular/integrated) are also eligible to apply. Candidates selected in the final merit list must submit proof of completing the qualifying degree with minimum 60% marks by emailing [email protected] by June 2026. Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 consists of 3 stages - Shortlisting based on normalised marks in qualifying degree, SSB Interview, and Medical Examination. There is no written examination. Marks obtained in the qualifying degree will be normalised using formulae available at https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf. The final merit list is prepared based on SSB marks. Candidates declared fit in the medical examination will be appointed subject to police verification, character verification, and availability of vacancies.

Mere inclusion in the Select List/Merit list does not confer a vested right to appointment. Empanelment is not to be treated as final selection and is not an enforceable claim to the post.

IISER Mohali Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

The selection process consists of multiple stages conducted by the Scrutiny/Selection Committee of IISER Mohali. The minimum qualifying marks for written/interview/skill tests will be as per standards fixed by the Institute at its discretion. The scheme of examination and syllabus for all posts will be announced at a later date on the Institute's website. Mere fulfilment of minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for test/interview.

Candidates selected to appear for the interview for Group A posts shall be reimbursed travel fare as follows - By Railways: AC II Tier; By Airways: up to 1000 km: Rs. 12,000/-; 1001–1500 km: Rs. 18,000/- (or actual, whichever is less); above 1500 km: Rs. 24,000/-. Air/Rail fare reimbursement is only on production of authentic tickets booked via authorized travel agents as per DoPT OM dated 29.08.2022.

Recruitment Process Steps

Stage Description
Stage 1 Submission of online application forms before the last date
Stage 2 Evaluation of application forms by the Scrutiny Committee; remarks published on IISER Mohali website
Stage 3 Representation(s) by applicants (if any) w.r.t. Scrutiny Committee remarks - evaluation of representations by Scrutiny Committee
Stage 4 Publication of final remarks of Scrutiny Committee on Institute website; no reconsideration request entertained after this stage
Stage 5 Written Test / Skill Test / Interview - as applicable per post (venue decided by IISER Mohali)

Shortlisting Criteria (may be adopted by Scrutiny Committee)

1 Higher educational qualifications than the minimum prescribed
2 Higher experience in relevant field than the minimum prescribed
3 Experience before and/or after acquisition of essential qualifications
4 Experience in relevant posts under Central/State Govt./Central/State funded Educational Institutes/Govt. Universities
5 Rejection of incomplete applications

How to Apply for IISER Mohali Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only at erp.iisermohali.ac.in. Applications received in hard copy format or any other mode will be summarily rejected. The last date is 15/06/2026 up to 05:00 PM. Candidates are advised to submit well before the closing date to avoid connectivity issues due to heavy load on the website. Once submitted, the application cannot be withdrawn under any circumstances and no editing will be allowed. All correspondence including admit cards will be sent to the registered email ID only - no hard copy letters will be sent.

Candidates serving in Central Government / State Government / Semi-Government / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies must upload the NOC/Forwarding Letter (Annexure-A) and Experience Certificate (Annexure-B) from their current employer before the last date of application, or submit by email to [email protected] before the date of written exam/interview.

Documents to be Produced at Written Test / Skill Test / Interview:

  • Original documents of all educational qualifications with mark sheets
  • Experience certificates clearly mentioning date of joining/promotion, Pay Level/Grade Pay, period of employment, and nature of duties
  • Category certificate - SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD/ESM (if applicable)
  • NOC / Forwarding letter from current employer (Annexure-A) - for Govt./PSU employees
  • Self-declaration for OBC-NCL (Annexure-I format)
  • Any other documents supporting claims made in the application form

Apply Online at: https://erp.iisermohali.ac.in/Online Recruitment Application IISERM.action

For technical support: [email protected] | For other queries: [email protected]

Important Instructions for IISER Mohali Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • The applicant must be a citizen of India. All posts are regular and permanent (except Lien vacancies).
  • Selected candidates will be covered under the National Pension System (NPS).
  • Candidates must satisfy themselves of the suitability for the position before applying - minimum essential qualifications are compulsory regardless of higher qualifications held.
  • CGPA to percentage conversion will be done as per formula of the degree-awarding institution.
  • OBC-NCL certificate must have been issued within 2 years of the last date of application and a self-declaration (Annexure-I) must also be submitted.
  • EWS certificate must be valid for Financial Year 2025-26 and clearly state the same.
  • If caste/category certificate is in a language other than Hindi or English, a certified translation must be produced at the time of interview/document verification.
  • Candidates must disclose details of any close relatives employed at IISER Mohali, and any penalties/inquiry against them in the application.
  • Canvassing in any form or bringing political or any other influence will be treated as disqualification.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post must pay the application fee separately for each post.
  • No hard copy/postal applications will be entertained - online mode only.
  • Once submitted, the application cannot be edited or withdrawn under any circumstances.
  • All correspondence will be made via registered email only - no separate hard copy letters will be sent.
  • Candidates selected for Group A post interviews are eligible for travel reimbursement (AC II Tier by rail; air fare as per slab with authorized travel agent tickets only).
  • Any corrigendum/addendum shall be published only on the Institute website. Candidates are advised to visit www.iisermohali.ac.in regularly.
  • Any legal dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to jurisdiction of the Hon'ble Punjab and Haryana High Court, Chandigarh only.
  • In case of ambiguity between Hindi and English versions of the advertisement, the English version shall prevail.
  • All decisions of the Competent Authority, IISER Mohali regarding eligibility, acceptance/rejection, selection, and related matters are final and binding.

Punjab Revenue Department Vacancy 2026

A total of 09 posts have been announced for contractual engagement under the NAKSHA Scheme's State Programme Management Unit (SPMU). The vacancies span across technical, administrative, and data management roles. Each post carries a specific remuneration and requires a distinct set of qualifications and experience. The tenure for all posts is initially one year. The post-wise vacancy and salary details are given in the table below.

Punjab Revenue Department Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they meet all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, work experience, and age limit for the respective post. Candidates not possessing the requisite qualifications are liable to be rejected. Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible to apply. The post-wise eligibility criteria are given below.

  • Nationality: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • ODL Restriction: Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible.
  • Foreign Degree: Candidates possessing degrees from foreign universities must produce an equivalency certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi at the time of interview or while applying.

Post-wise Educational Qualification & Work Experience

Post Name Educational Qualification & Work Experience Required
Project Coordinator Education: Master's in Engineering / Business Administration / Development Studies / Social Work OR Bachelor's in Engineering / Science or related field.

Work Experience: 1) Minimum 5 years' experience in implementing and coordinating projects related to Central/State Government programmes or public/private sector schemes. 2) Proven track record in data analysis, project management and coordination, demonstrating effective leadership and problem-solving skills in achieving project objectives and ensuring smooth programme operations.
Expert (Land Administration) Work Experience: Retired Civil Service Officers with a minimum of 10 years of experience in land administration, revenue/registration/consolidation/survey.
Manager (Geospatial Technology) Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology from a recognized University or Institute in a relevant field such as Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Geomatics Engineering, or related disciplines. GATE qualified and certification in GIS/Data analysis related courses with knowledge of ArcGIS/QGIS and other software related to GIS data processing and management is desirable.

Work Experience: At least 5 years of experience in managing and execution of GIS-related projects. Proficiency in utilising GIS software such as ArcGIS, QGIS and other relevant tools for spatial data processing, mapping and database management.
Programmer (MIS & GIS Developer) Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science, preferably in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years' experience in database administration, encompassing database design, implementation, optimisation and maintenance. Proficiency in GIS-based software tool development, with a track record of designing and deploying solutions to meet project requirements.
GIS Technical Expert Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master's in Computer Applications/Geo-informatics or relevant fields.

Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in the development of GIS-based software tools. Demonstrated proficiency in designing, developing and implementing GIS solutions to meet project requirements and objectives.
Remote Sensing Analyst Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master's in Computer Applications/Geo-informatics or relevant fields.

Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in maintaining High Resolution Satellite Imageries and software tools like ERDAS Imagine, LPS, QGIS, ArcGIS is preferred. Demonstrated proficiency in Ortho rectification, mosaicking, analysis using satellite data to meet project requirements and objectives.
Data Entry Operator Education: Bachelor's degree in any stream.

Work Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience and proficient typing skills in either English or Punjabi are preferred. Possession of valid certification in MS Word and MS Excel / MS Office issued by a recognised institute certified under ISO standards is desirable.

The selection process for Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 is based on a screening and interview mechanism. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their educational qualification marks and relevant experience marks as per the scoring criteria defined for each post.

Only the Top 50 shortlisted candidates (based on Sections A and B scores) will be called for interview/technical interaction. The final merit list will be prepared by adding screening marks and interview marks. The post-wise selection criteria with total marks of 100 are detailed below.

How to Apply for Punjab Revenue Department Recruitment 2026

The application process for Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Applications must be submitted in the prescribed proforma through the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ on or before 15/05/2026. Applications received after the due date, unsigned applications, or incomplete applications (without photograph, signature, mark sheets, or incomplete in any respect) will not be considered. The step-by-step process to apply is given below.

  • Visit the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ and find the NAKSHA Scheme recruitment advertisement.
  • Download and fill the prescribed application proforma carefully with all required details.
  • Attach attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, a recent passport-size photograph, and relevant experience certificates.
  • If applying for more than one post, submit a separate application for each post.
  • If Grades/CGPA are awarded instead of marks, candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per the University's conversion procedure and submit necessary proof. Rounding off of percentage of marks/CGPA grading is not allowed.
  • Submit the completed application online at https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ before the closing date of 15/05/2026.
  • Keep a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
  • For any queries, contact Under Secretary (Revenue) at [email protected].

Punjab Revenue Department Application Form 2026

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 can do so by submitting their application in the prescribed proforma online through the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/. The application process is online only, and candidates must ensure that all required documents and information are complete before the closing date of 15/05/2026.

In case of submission of duplicate or multiple applications against a particular position, the latest application submitted before the closing date shall be considered for further processing. Candidates are advised to retain a copy of their submitted application and all supporting documents as they will be required to produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies at the time of the selection process.

Apply Online at: https://jamabandi.punjab.gov.in/req/Recruitment.aspx

Candidates are advised to read all instructions carefully before applying for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026. Non-compliance with any of the instructions may result in rejection of the application at any stage of the recruitment process. The key instructions issued by the Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management are listed below.

  • Applications must be submitted online in the prescribed proforma along with attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, a recent passport-size photograph, and relevant experience certificates.
  • Candidates not possessing the requisite qualifications for the posts are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible to apply.

  • Candidates called for interview must produce all relevant original documents along with a set of self-attested photocopies at the time of the selection process.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.
  • Candidates are advised to check their email and visit the Revenue Department's website from time to time. The Department will not be responsible for non-receipt of intimation regarding call letters or any communication due to technical reasons or otherwise.
  • Only Indian nationals need to apply.
  • Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.
  • Applications received after the due date, unsigned applications, or incomplete applications will not be considered.
  • The Department reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to summary disqualification.
  • If any information furnished in the application form is found to be wrong, false, or incomplete, the candidate will not be called for interview.
  • Candidates who fail to produce original degree or diploma certificates, proof of date of birth, conversion factor of CGPA, mark sheets, etc., will not be entertained.

SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they fulfil all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, Punjabi language requirement, and the cut-off date for qualifications.

SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Selection Process 2026

The selection process for SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Recruitment 2026 consists of an Objective Type Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) written examination followed by counselling and document verification. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination.

There will be negative marking in the written examination - each question carries 1 mark and ¼ mark will be deducted for each wrong answer. Only candidates whose eligibility is fully established will be recommended to the concerned department on the basis of written examination merit. The detailed selection process is given below.

Stage Details
1. Written Examination Objective Type MCQ written examination; each question carries 1 mark; negative marking of ¼ mark per wrong answer
2. Merit List Preparation Merit list prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination. Tie-breaking order: (i) Date of Birth (older candidate preferred), (ii) Higher percentage in required educational qualification, (iii) Higher marks in Matriculation
3. Counselling & Document Verification Candidates called for counselling based on merit; number of candidates to be called decided by the Board keeping in view category-wise vacancies; candidates must produce original certificates and attested copies of all required documents

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

Phase-I – General Cadre (200 Marks, Objective MCQ, 120 Minutes)

The paper covers General Awareness, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, and Reasoning. Separate time will be allotted for each section. Detailed information will be provided in the Information Handout available with the Admit Card.

Phase-II – General Cadre

Paper-I (Economic and Social Issues): Growth and Development (National Income, poverty alleviation, sustainable development); Indian Economy (economic history, monetary and fiscal policy since 1991, Indian money and financial markets, public finance, agriculture, services sector); Globalization (BoP, export-import policy, IMF, World Bank, WTO); Social Structure in India (multiculturalism, demographic trends, urbanization, gender issues, social justice).

Paper-II (English – Writing Skills): Writing skills including expression and understanding of the topic.

Paper-III (General Finance and Management): Financial system (structure of financial institutions, RBI functions, banking system, digital payments); Financial markets (primary and secondary markets); General topics (financial risk management, derivatives, financial inclusion, corporate governance, Union Budget, accounting basics, inflation); Management (fundamentals, organizational behaviour, motivation, leadership, ethics, corporate governance, communication).

Phase-I – DEPR Cadre (Paper-I, Objective – Economics)

Microeconomics, Macroeconomics (IS-LM Model, schools of economic thought), International Economics, Theories of Economic Growth and Development, Public Finance, Environmental Economics, Quantitative Methods in Economics, Current developments in Indian Economy.

Phase-II – DEPR Cadre (Descriptive – Economics)

Paper-I covers Microeconomics Module (consumer theory, production theory, market theory, welfare economics) and Macroeconomics Module (national income accounting, employment and output, inflation, money and banking, growth theories, international trade, public finance) with equal weightage. Paper-II covers Quantitative Methods in Economics (mathematical methods, statistical methods, econometrics) and Indian Economy – Policy and Trends (fiscal policy, monetary policy, banking sector, inflation, external sector, sectoral developments) with equal weightage.

Phase-I – DSIM Cadre (Paper-I, Objective – Statistics) and Phase-II (Paper-II, Descriptive – Statistics)

Topics covered across both papers: Theory of Probability, Probability Distributions and Sampling Theory; Linear Models and Economic Statistics; Statistical Inference (Estimation, Testing of Hypothesis, Non-Parametric Tests); Stochastic Processes; Multivariate Analysis; Econometrics and Time Series; Optimization and Statistical Computing; Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Techniques; Database and Data Warehouse Management.

Tribal Development Department Chowkidar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions specified below on the date of advertisement (27/04/2026) to apply for the post of Chowkidar. The minimum educational qualification is passing the Secondary School Certificate (SSC / 10th Standard) examination.

Merely possessing the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to be recommended - the final selection is strictly on the basis of merit in the computer-based examination. All service entry rules as per Maharashtra government norms and as amended from time to time will apply throughout the recruitment process. Candidates are advised to apply only after verifying their eligibility in full.

Criteria Details
Nationality Indian
Educational Qualification Must have passed Secondary School Certificate (SSC / 10th Standard) Examination
Qualification Date Candidate must have acquired the prescribed educational qualification as on the date of advertisement (27/04/2026)
Domicile Candidate must be a resident of Maharashtra. Candidates from 865 Marathi-speaking villages in the Maharashtra-Karnataka border area may also apply, subject to submission of valid domicile certificate issued by competent authority.
Reservation Benefit Only available to candidates who are general residents of Maharashtra as defined under Section 20 of the Representation of the People Act, 1950.

Tribal Development Department Chowkidar Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

The age of candidates will be calculated on the closing date for online applications (18/05/2026). The general upper age limit and relaxations are governed by Government Resolution, General Administration Department No. SRV-2015/P.No.404/Work.12, dated 25 April 2016.

Age relaxation is available to candidates belonging to government-recognized backward categories, Divyang (PH), Ex-Servicemen, Sportspersons, and Part-time employees as per respective government orders.

Creamy Layer candidates in VJ-A, NT-B, NT-C, NT-D, Vimapra, Imav (SBC), SEBC, and EWS categories are not eligible for age relaxation. Candidates should verify their age eligibility from the official notification before applying.

Category Age Limit / Relaxation
General (Open/Unreserved) As per GR dated 25 April 2016 (standard age limits for government posts)
Government-recognized Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) Age relaxation as per Maharashtra Govt. rules
Divyang (PH) - All categories Maximum upper age limit: 45 years (as per GAD GR No. SRV-1998/P.No.39/16-A, dated 16.01.2001)
Sportspersons Maximum upper age limit: 43 years (including reserved category candidates) as per School Education & Sports Dept. GR dated 06.10.2010
Ex-Servicemen Relaxation equal to military service period + 3 years (as per GAD GR dated 20.08.2010); Divyang Ex-Servicemen - additional relaxation as applicable
Part-time Government Employees Relaxation as per GAD GR dated 02.01.2019
Creamy Layer candidates (VJ-A, NT-B, NT-C, NT-D, Vimapra, Imav, SEBC, EWS) No age relaxation available

Tribal Development Department Chowkidar Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process & Exam Pattern

Selection for the post of Chowkidar (Watchman) will be done entirely on the basis of a Computer-Based Online Examination (CBT) in Marathi medium. There is no physical or trade test for this post. The examination will be of 200 marks, comprising 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 2 marks each, to be completed in 120 minutes (2 hours).

The exam will be held at district headquarters across Maharashtra. Candidates must score a minimum of 45% marks to be eligible for inclusion in the merit list. Final appointment will be made on the basis of the merit list prepared from the online examination scores. In case of equal marks between two or more candidates, the tie-breaking priority order will be as per Government Resolution, GAD No. Pranimbh-1222/P.No.54/Ka.13-A, dated 4 May 2022.

Examination Pattern

Post Name Marathi English General Knowledge Intellectual/Aptitude Test Total Marks Duration
Chowkidar (Watchman) 50 50 50 50 200 120 Minutes

Key Rules for the Online Examination:

Point Details
Exam Mode Computer-Based Online Examination (CBT)
Question Type Objective Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ) - 2 marks per question
Medium of Examination Marathi only
Exam Centers District headquarters across Maharashtra (subject to change)
Minimum Qualifying Marks 45% of total marks
Banned Items Mobile phone, calculator, iPad, or any electronic/communication device strictly banned at exam center
Scribe (Lekhanik) Facility Available for visually impaired and candidates with permanent writing disability (must be declared in application form); 20 extra minutes per hour provided
Extra Time for PH Candidates Locomotor/Cerebral Palsy (min. 40% disability): 20 extra minutes per hour; Visually impaired (more than 40% disability): 20 extra minutes per hour + magnified font option available
Multiple Sessions If conducted in multiple sessions, scores will be normalized across sessions to ensure parity
Admit Card Available for download from https://tdcwatchman2026.cbtexam.in - will not be sent by post or any other means
Result Final result published on https://tribal.maharashtra.gov.in

How to Apply for Tribal Development Department Chowkidar Recruitment 2026

Applications will be accepted through online mode only at https://tdcwatchman2026.cbtexam.in. No offline or postal applications will be entertained. Candidates do not need to upload supporting certificates at the time of applying - however, all information entered in the online application must be accurate and complete.

The online application portal is open from 27/04/2026 to 18/05/2026 (till 11:55 PM). New candidates must first register, after which a temporary Registration Number and Password will be generated and sent to their registered mobile number/email.

Step-by-Step Online Application Process:

  • Visit https://tdcwatchman2026.cbtexam.in and click on "APPLY ONLINE".
  • Click "Click here for New Registration" - enter name, contact details, and email ID. A temporary Registration Number and Password will be displayed on screen and sent via SMS/email. Note these carefully.
  • Log in using the Registration Number and Password. Fill in all required details including personal information, address, category, Aadhaar number, and educational qualifications.
  • Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress. Verify all details carefully before final submission.
  • Upload the following scanned documents as per specifications: passport-size colour photograph (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm), signature in black ink on white paper, left thumb impression in black/blue ink on white paper, handwritten declaration in English on white paper in black ink (in capital letters is NOT acceptable).
  • Select the post and ITDP project office for which you are applying.
  • Click "Proceed to Payment" and pay the examination fee online.
  • After successful payment, an E-Receipt will be generated - download and save it.
  • Take a printout of the completed application form and E-Receipt. Retain until the entire recruitment process is complete.

Documents to be Uploaded (Scanned, JPG/JPEG format):

Document Dimensions File Size
Passport-size colour photograph (recent, light background) 200 x 230 pixels (preferred); 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm 20 KB to 50 KB
Signature in black ink on white paper (not in capital letters) 140 x 60 pixels (preferred) 10 KB to 20 KB
Left thumb impression in black/blue ink on white paper 240 x 240 pixels at 200 DPI; 3 cm x 3 cm 20 KB to 50 KB
Handwritten declaration in English (black ink, white paper, NOT in capitals) 800 x 400 pixels at 200 DPI; 10 cm x 5 cm 50 KB to 100 KB

Apply Online at: https://tdcwatchman2026.cbtexam.in/Candidate/EntryForm.aspx

Official Website: https://tribal.maharashtra.gov.in

Documents Required at the Time of Examination / Document Verification

Candidates are not required to submit supporting documents at the time of the online application. However, after publication of the interim merit list based on online examination scores, shortlisted candidates will be called for a thorough document verification. If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage, their candidature will be cancelled. Candidates must carry the following documents to the examination center:

  • Valid Admit Card (downloaded from the official website)
  • Original Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card / Passport / Driving License / Voter ID / Aadhaar Card with photo / Bank Passbook with photo / College/University valid ID / Employee ID / Bar Council ID with photo)
  • Photocopy of the Photo Identity Proof

Ration Card and temporary driving licence are NOT accepted as valid identity proof. The name on the admit card must exactly match the name on the identity proof. Female candidates who have changed their name after marriage must carry original Gazette Notification / Marriage Registration Certificate / Affidavit as proof of name change.

Documents for Final Document Verification (after shortlisting):

  • Printout of submitted online application form
  • Educational qualification certificates (SSC onwards)
  • Copy of examination fee payment receipt
  • Caste Certificate / Caste Validity Certificate / Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (as applicable to category)
  • Other relevant certificates as applicable (Domicile, Disability, Ex-Servicemen, Sports, Orphan, EWS, etc.)

Important Instructions for Tribal Development Chowkidar Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only online applications are accepted - no hard copy, postal, or offline applications will be entertained.
  • Certificates need not be uploaded at the time of online application - however, all details entered must be truthful and accurate.
  • Online application information cannot be modified after fee payment is completed.
  • Candidates must have a valid personal email ID and active mobile number for the entire duration of the recruitment process.
  • Admit cards will be available for self-download only from the official website - no other mode of delivery.
  • Candidates must arrive at the examination center at least 1 hour before the scheduled start time to complete verification formalities.
  • Mobile phones, calculators, iPads, and all electronic/communication devices are strictly banned inside the examination premises - violation will lead to disqualification and debarment from future exams.
  • Candidates who wish to use a scribe (lekhanik) must declare this in the online application form - requests made later will not be entertained.
  • The scribe must not be a candidate in the same examination; one scribe cannot serve more than one candidate.
  • If false, tampered, or incomplete information is submitted at any stage, the candidature will be cancelled, and the candidate may face criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates who share answers with others or adopt unfair means will have their candidature cancelled and results withheld.
  • Reservation benefits (social, horizontal, or concession) are available only to candidates with valid certificates issued by competent authorities before the closing date of application.
  • For Women reservation: a valid Maharashtra domicile certificate must be submitted. Non-Creamy Layer requirement for open category women's posts has been waived as per Women & Child Development Department GR dated 04 May 2023.
  • EWS certificate must be produced at the time of document verification as per prescribed format issued by competent authority.
  • Orphan candidates must submit a certificate issued by the Women & Child Development Department authority only - certificates from other agencies will not be accepted.
  • Ex-Servicemen must clearly claim their status in the application; must have their name registered with the District Sainik Board and present original certificates at verification.
  • The department reserves the right to cancel/modify/alter recruitment conditions - announcements will be published on the official website only.
  • All examination-related disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the competent court as per applicable law.

  • Ensuring delivery of error-free reports within scheduled timelines

Shortlisted candidates will be called for Field Trials at a designated venue, the evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off for which will be determined solely by the Bank. How to Apply for BPCL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply ONLINE only through the official BPCL website. No other mode of application will be accepted. The online application process is open from 18 April 2026 to 24 May 2026 (23:59 hrs).

Step-by-Step Application Process

  1. Check Eligibility: Ensure that you meet all the eligibility criteria including educational qualification, age limit, and work experience before applying. No eligibility-related queries will be entertained.
  2. Keep Documents Ready: Prepare scanned copies (PDF format) of the following documents:
    • Date of Birth Proof (Class 10th/12th Certificate)
    • Educational Qualification Certificates (Marksheet + Degree/Diploma)
    • Work Experience Certificates (with job role, duration, salary, etc.)
    • Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable)
    • Recent Passport Size Photograph (latest, not older than April 2026)

    • Use “Save & Next” to verify details
  5. Upload Documents: Upload photograph, signature, and required documents as per prescribed format.
  6. Preview Application: Carefully review all details using the Preview Tab before final submission. No changes will be allowed after submission.
  7. Pay Application Fee:

    • Ensure payment status shows “Completed”
    • Take a printout of payment receipt
  8. Final Submission: Click on “Submit” to complete the application process.

Important Instructions

  • Apply only once; multiple applications may lead to rejection.

  • Ensure all details match original documents; mismatch may lead to disqualification.

  • Attach a photocopy of the fee payment receipt with the application - applications without receipt will not be accepted.
  • Submit the completed application in person at the Dispatch Section, Seth V. C. Gandhi & M. A. Vora Municipal General Hospital, Rajawadi Hospital, Ghatkopar (East) on or before 15 May 2026 between 11:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. (Monday to Friday).

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Other Benefits

In addition to the consolidated monthly pay mentioned against each post, MECON offers a comprehensive benefits package to all contractual employees. Employees deployed at site/project locations receive a Site Allowance of 7.5% of pay, while those at Metro locations receive a Metro Allowance of 2.5% of pay. An annual increment on consolidated pay (rounded to the next ten rupees) is provided subject to company rules. Medical facilities including OPD and IPD treatment are available at Ispat Hospital, Ranchi, for employees posted at Ranchi (covering self, spouse, and 2 dependent children). For other locations, a company-retained doctor provides free consultation. Additionally, reimbursement of up to ₹15,000 per year towards Mediclaim premium (₹4,00,000 on floater basis) is available as per company policy.

Company accommodation (family or bachelor) may be provided based on availability at applicable charges; if not availed, HRA at 5% of consolidated pay is payable. Leave entitlements include Casual Leave (12 days/year), Earned Leave (18 days/year, accumulation up to 45 days), Half Pay Leave (14 days/year with commutation on medical certificate), and Maternity Leave as applicable to regular employees. National, Festival, and Restricted Holidays (4 nos.) are as per regular employee norms. All employees are covered under a Group Personal Accident Policy with a Sum Insured of ₹25 Lakhs.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit & Relaxation

The upper age limit for each post is 50 years for General (UR) and EWS category candidates, as calculated on the cut-off date of 23.03.2026. Age relaxation is provided as per Government of India guidelines. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates get a relaxation of 3 years, SC/ST candidates get 5 years, and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) get relaxation of 10 years (General), 13 years (OBC-NCL), or 15 years (SC/ST).

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Reservations & Relaxations

Reservations for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwD (Persons with Disability - 40% or above), and EWS candidates are provided as per Government of India guidelines. Reservation for PwD is on a horizontal basis. SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR category posts will be considered on General category merit - no age relaxation or fee waiver applies to them in such cases. OBC (NCL) candidates must produce a valid certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India; the certificate must not be more than 1 year old as on the date of advertisement. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority (such as District Magistrate, Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar rank, etc.) in the prescribed format available on MECON's website. The crucial date for the Income and Asset Certificate is the closing date for online applications.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying under UR, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), or EWS category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹500 (Rupees Five Hundred only). Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwD, or Ex-Servicemen categories, as well as internal MECON candidates, are fully exempted from paying any fee.

The application fee must be paid online through the payment gateway provided on MECON's official website. No other mode of payment (such as demand draft, postal order, or cash) is accepted. Once the fee is paid, candidates must click the "Verify" button to update the application status to "Submitted." Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates are strongly advised to verify their eligibility before making payment. Applications submitted without fee or with insufficient fee will be rejected.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Selection Mode

The selection process for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-In-Interview. Walk-In-Interviews will be conducted at four locations - Delhi, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Bangalore - and the specific dates and times will be published on the MECON Careers page. Candidates must apply online before appearing for the interview.

On the date of the Walk-In-Interview, document scrutiny will be undertaken; if any claim in the application is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA will be reimbursed. The final list of selected candidates will be published on MECON's website and communicated via registered email ID only. MECON reserves the right to change the mode of selection at its discretion.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Travelling Allowance (TA) for Interview

Outstation candidates who appear for the Walk-In-Interview are entitled to reimbursement of travelling allowance (TA) for to-and-fro travel by the shortest route from their mailing address (as mentioned in the application) to the interview venue. TA will be paid at III Tier AC (3A) / Chair Car (CC) rail fare rates, or ₹7 per km by road, whichever is less, subject to production of original tickets/receipts and/or boarding passes. Rail fare will be at regular (non-Tatkal/non-premium Tatkal) rates only. Internal MECON candidates will be governed by company service rules.

Candidates should note that scrutiny of applications is conducted on the interview date itself - if any claim is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. TA forms must be submitted along with proof of travel, bank account number, and IFSC code of the bank branch for payment processing.

How to Apply for MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026

Applications for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through MECON's official website (www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online). No offline or postal applications will be accepted. Candidates must apply between 27 April 2026 and 11 May 2026. During the online application process, candidates must upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), a signature image in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), and self-attested PDF copies of all required documents.

If multiple documents need to be merged, they must be combined into a single PDF not exceeding 1 MB. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will result in summary rejection. No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application, so candidates must take utmost care before final submission.

Government/PSU employees must forward their application through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the time of the interview; failure to do so means they will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. Hard copies of the online application and all required documents must be brought on the date of the Walk-In-Interview.

Documents to be uploaded online:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
  • Signature in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
  • Matriculation/Secondary Board certificate or Municipal Birth Certificate (proof of age)
  • Final/Provisional Graduation and Post-Graduation certificates (as applicable)
  • All semester/year-wise mark sheets or consolidated mark sheet
  • Work experience certificates/documents as per Para 6 of the notification
  • PAN Card and Aadhaar Card
  • Caste certificate - OBC (NCL) / EWS / SC / ST (as applicable; OBC certificate not more than 1 year old)
  • PwD certificate in prescribed Govt. of India format (if applicable)
  • Income & Asset Certificate for EWS candidates as per DoPT OM No.36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31.01.2019
  • Discharge/Service Certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • J&K Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
  • Meritorious Sportsperson Certificate (if applicable)

Important Instructions for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All documents must be self-attested; third-party attestation is not required unless specifically mentioned.
  • Original certificates/documents must be produced at the time of the Walk-In-Interview.
  • No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application.
  • Government/PSU employees must produce NOC from present employer at interview.
  • Certificates in languages other than Hindi/English must be accompanied by a certified translation.
  • Candidates must maintain a valid and active email ID and mobile number for at least 1 year - all future communications will be through email only.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only.
  • MECON's decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

  • A written test and/or presentation.
  • A final personal interview before the Selection Committee.
  • Note: Candidates must appear in person; no TA/DA will be provided.

How to apply

Candidates must submit their applications in hard copy while also filling out an online "Candidate Summary".

  • Online Summary: Fill out the summary on the NIT Sikkim website.
  • Hard Copy Submission: Download and type the application form (Part A and B).
  • Enclosures: Include self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience, category certificates, credit point claims, and the payment receipt.
  • Mailing Address: Send the sealed envelope to: The Director, National Institute of Technology Sikkim, Ravangla, District - Namchi, Sikkim, PIN - 737139 (India).
  • Envelope Labeling: Super-scribe the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [NAME] IN THE DEPARTMENT OF [NAME]".
